author: Claudio F
title: Ricambi sempre pronti
content: Ho preso questo set di calzini per le mie figlie. Non sono i classici calzini sportivi usa e getta sottili come veline. Al tatto il cotone si sente, con quella morbidezza naturale che il sintetico integrale non riesce mai a replicare. Indossandoli, la struttura ammortizzata sul tallone e sulla punta avvolge il piede in modo confortevole, rendendo il passo più morbido sia durante l'attività sportiva che nell'uso quotidiano. La scelta della variante a tre colori per me è stata vantaggiosa, così possono variare senza uscire da un look sobrio e tecnico. U La fascia di supporto sull'arco plantare è un dettaglio apprezzabile: comprime il giusto, mantenendo il calzino fermo senza stringere eccessivamente, il che evita quegli odiosi scivolamenti all'interno della scarpa mentre si corre. Anche la gestione dell'umidità è promossa: la maglia traspirante sul dorso del piede fa il suo lavoro, mantenendo la pelle asciutta e fresca anche dopo diverse ore di attività. Essendo così ricchi di cotone e strutturalmente ben imbottiti, risultano più spessi della media: se si hanno delle scarpe da running fin troppo precise, si potrebbe avvertire una calzata un po' troppo compressa. Inoltre, questa consistenza ammortizzata tende a trattenere un po' più di calore rispetto a un calzino tecnico ultra-sottile in microfibra, rendendoli forse meno indicati per le giornate particolarmente calde. In definitiva, una buona scelta di comfort e protezione.

content: Los calcetines vienen en su propia caja con un estilo muy elegante y discreto. content: I bought these because my feet tend to get very cold, particularly after losing weight, so I wanted a pair of thermal socks to wear around the house. I like the natural colours of the set and they look nice without being overly bright or patterned. The socks are warm and comfortable, and I often wear them around the house instead of slipper socks. They’re soft rather than scratchy, and the elastic around the ankle isn’t tight or restrictive. The fit was perfect for me (UK size 7) and they stay up well without sliding down. I usually wear them over tights or a thinner pair of bamboo socks when it’s particularly cold, but they’re not so thick that you can’t wear normal shoes or boots over them. I’ve worn them out a few times and they kept my feet warm without any issues. Inoltre, in un paio la cucitura sulla punta si avverte leggermente quando indosso scarpe molto aderenti. author: cherry
title: Better than Nike, Puma, and Hames socks.
content: I've been looking for socks that sit an inch or two above the ankle bone, so they can double as everyday socks and basketball socks. Whenever I play basketball, my basketball shoes always rub against my ankle bone if my socks are too short or thin. I usually buy Nike socks for this reason, but they're so expensive. I tried Hames, but they keep getting holes in them after a few months and they get really sweaty fast. So, I gave these a try instead. This is what I'll be buying from now on. They're way cheaper than Nike socks, and they're as good if not better. The fit is perfect, the material is durable yet comfy and breathable, and the design isn't too obnoxious. Also, the packaging it came in was really nice for some reason lol. I'm recommending these to EVERYBODY from now on. I'll update my review if they're quick to develop holes or tears, but I doubt that will happen with how good this material is. UPDATE: It's been a little over 3 months now, and some of these socks have started to form holes. The packaging says that you should "air-dry only", but I've been putting them in the dryer every time I wash them. There was a noticable drop in quality after drying them a few times; they were less smooth and soft. I'm planning on buying another pack and ONLY air-drying them, because I think they would've had a longer lifespan if I followed the instructions. Most of the socks are still wearable though. After the walk they did feel tight on my big toe, but not dreadful. A hole has appeared on one at this spot.] Original review of Closemate trainer socks I’m not really used to this style of ultra minimal trainer sock (I usually get the ones that are a bit bigger/come up a bit higher than these). But interested to try as I can see the thin material and lower cut being possibly better in the summer (remember that?). First impressions are of something very small which surely won’t fit my size 12s. OK – they do go on as they stretch to an extraordinary degree. I’ve worn them around the house a lot and also out wearing a pair of leather loafers. In those I did some very quick walking to see how they fared as well. Overall it’s impressive how they stay on (as others have said). I did have them come off the heel once, but not again so far. I’m in two minds about comfort and possible durability however. At the upper end of their size range (I’m 11.5/12) they are stretched very tight. I can feel that on my big toe and have a concern that a) they won’t be comfortable worn like that all day and b) they won’t last because they are so stretched. I don’t find them uncomfortable so far, but I am “aware” of them on big toe all the time so I couldn’t describe them as comfortable either. Durability? Who knows – but I am doubtful that these will last long – just so thin? That said, they are a good price compared to alternatives so this may matter less. They are also very cool as hoped. So cool in fact that I had to change back to warmer socks in the house the other day because of the poor summer we’ve been having.

Como detalle trae un alargo de contorno que sirve para poner en ambos lados de los cierres, nunca lo había visto y me ha parecido muy original. ⬇️ Algo que no me ha gustado nada es que lleva las ranuras como si la ligera espumilla que da forma a la copa se pudiese extraer, pero es imposible hacerlo sin romper el sujetador ya que las partes superiores están entre las costuras invisibles; es posible que si hubiese podido quitar las esponjillas el sujetador me hubiese servido. Lo que sí me gusta es que los tirantes se pueden cruzar o poner en otras posiciones, aunque sólo la parte trasera. En resumen, aunque es un sujetador bonito y muy bien presentado, considero que el fabricante debe mejorar la calidad (en cuando a no coser las espumillas o, en su defecto no dar la posibilidad de extraerlas) así como ser transparente en cuanto al tallaje, para mi eso es un error enorme ya que ahora me quedo con un sujetador que no puedo usar. Del precio poco puedo opinar ya que al no ser mi talla no puedo evaluar si la relación calidad/comodidad/precio merece la pena (en el momento de escribir esta opinión el precio es de 26.99€ + 10% de descuento con entrega Prime en 24h).

author: Dorcas
title: Sujeta poco y molestan las ballenas laterales
content: Sujetador sin aros ni costuras, escote V. Modelo 3XL, color marrón. ✔️ A destacar: El sujetador viene muy bien empaquetado en una discreta caja con cierre de imán, cubierto con un papel de la marca y acompañado de un par de etiquetas y una ampliación de corchetes, que es un detalle muy útil. Paquete ideal para regalo. Al tacto el tejido es suave, ligero y elástico. Los tirantes son extensibles y no están cerrados a la estructura, lo que te permite sacarlos y poder ponerlos en "X", cruzados en la espalda, también. La forma de las copas hace que tengan buena capacidad por la profundidad. Los colores y el diseño son discretos si no quieres que se noten bajo la ropa. Tienes varias tallas y colores para elegir. 🔴 A mejorar: El material es muy sintético, nailon y elastano. Siendo una prenda interior que usas en una zona donde la piel es fina y sensible, sería más deseable que el material fuera de mejor calidad. No se puede meter en la lavadora. Al ser una prenda que hay que lavar a menudo, me parece un trastorno tener que estar lavándola a mano. Los tirantes son muy estrechos para las que usamos talla grande, lo que hace que se te vayan hincando en el hombro a medida que pasan las horas y te va creando marca en la piel, además de que molesta. Con las ballenas pasa un poco lo mismo en la talla grande, no refuerzan suficiente, se te clavan en la carne provocando incomodidad. La sujeción que tiene es muy débil. El tejido y el tipo de armazón no ofrecen sostenimiento adecuado. De aspecto es un sujetador muy poco atractivo, por el color y por la excesiva sencillez del diseño. ⚠️ Importante: Talla justo, si estás al límite de las medidas y dudas, te aconsejo que pidas una talla más. Según la etiqueta hay que lavarlo a mano. 📖 Resumen: Lo valoro desde el punto de vista de una talla grande que necesita sujeción a la par que comodidad y este sujetador no me ha aportado ninguna de ellas, por las ballenas que no refuerzan suficiente, los tirantes que son muy estrechos y el tejido que es demasiado elástico y débil para poder aportar el afianzamiento suficiente.

author: Mr Tester
title: They looked really tiny, but did fit my size 10 feet! Material thinner than expected.
content: The CLOSEMATE 12 pairs of trainer socks arrive in a zip-lock polythene bag and I like the selection of colours (2 x black, 2 x grey, 2 x white). When I initially opened out a pair of the socks I thought they looked much much smaller than I was expecting. I take a size 10 shoe/trainer and the size of socks ordered was for 9 to 12. However, I must admit that they did fit my feet quite well as the material is exceptionally stretchy. The material is also very thin, and stretching them over my feet made the material feel even thinner. I have had this type of sock before and previously the socks have been made from a thicker material - the CLOSEMATE ones are a thinner material and I would have liked a slightly heavier fabric by choice. I guess some people might prefer the thinner material though so it's down to personal taste I guess. I like the three bands of silicone that are situated on the inside of the heel, it seemed like a good idea. However, how that wears and whether it might 'rub' a little only time will tell. Therefore I think, on reflection, that I would have preferred not to have the silicone. On my size 10 feet, even though the socks did fit me I found that the sides of the socks were rather low. I do wonder what they'd be like on a size 12 foot as they'd be stretched even further. At just over £2 per pair I think the value is quite good and the 80% cotton is a good feature for breathability. Overall I think these socks are okay, but for me the material is too thin (and would offer very little 'comfort' as such), the sides are a bit too low and I actually think I would have preferred not to have the silicone strips. Maybe I am being a bit picky but sadly they aren't going to be my 'invisible sock' of choice, sorry to say.

content: Los Closemates Calcetinos Tobilleros dicen ser de bambú e ideales para verano. Pues, no puedo hacer un análisis de la fibra, pero en comparación con otros calcetines que tengo de bambú, noto una diferencia. Ahí lo dejo. Tampoco los considero especialmente indicados para temporadas de temperaturas altas, pues son relativamente gruesos y hacen que me suden los pies incluso sin actividad física. CUando llegaron tenían un olor químico intenso, que se quitó tras lavarlos. No concuerdo con la reseña alemana que reclama que no adoptan olor - tras usarlos huelen como todos los calcetines, y quizás más rápidos porque incrementan la sudoración. En cuanto a la talla, quedan relativamente bien. No se adaptan al pie a la perfección pero tampoco quedan arrugas. Son bastante elásticos. Probe usarlos para correr y me salieron ampollas. I have used both budget multipacks and higher-end branded running socks, so I had a fair benchmark when trying this 6-pack from CLOSEMATE. The first thing I noticed is the cushioning. The terry padding under the heel and forefoot is noticeable without feeling bulky. During a 5 to 8 km run, they provided enough shock absorption to stay comfortable, especially in standard running trainers. They are not ultra-thin performance socks, but they are not overly thick either. For everyday training, the balance works. Fit is snug in a good way. They grip the midfoot well, and I did not experience slipping inside the shoe. The ankle height sits just above the shoe line, which helps prevent rubbing at the heel collar. I did not develop any blisters while using them, including on longer walks and moderate runs, which suggests the anti-blister claim has some merit. Moisture management is decent but not exceptional. After a harder session, the socks were damp but not soaked. They dry reasonably quickly after washing. Compared to premium technical running socks, breathability is slightly lower, but for the price bracket and multipack format, performance is acceptable. Durability so far has been solid. After multiple washes, they have held their shape and elasticity without thinning out or developing loose threads. Time will tell how they perform over several months, but early signs are positive. Overall, these are reliable, comfortable training socks that suit general gym work and moderate running. They are not elite-level performance gear, but they are also not flimsy budget throwaways. If you want a practical, cushioned multipack for regular training without paying premium brand prices, this set delivers reasonable value and comfort.

author: Marco Bonvini
title: Ben fatti, materiale buono, ma vestibilità non per tutti
content: I calzini si presentano molto bene: l’aspetto è curato, i materiali sembrano di buona qualità e le rifiniture sono adeguate. La confezione contiene 6 paia, ciascuno arrotolato singolarmente, all’interno di un sacchetto. Anche l’imballaggio è ordinato e fa una buona impressione. Una volta indossati risultano morbidi e confortevoli, piacevoli al tatto e adatti all’uso quotidiano. Tuttavia, dal mio punto di vista hanno un limite: non sono particolarmente aderenti. Per un utilizzo sportivo mi aspetterei una calzata più “ferma”, mentre in questo caso il piede tende a muoversi leggermente all’interno, dando una sensazione di minore stabilità. Potrebbe anche essere una questione di vestibilità: ho preso la taglia 39–42 e porto il 42, quindi sono al limite superiore della fascia. Curiosamente, a mia moglie (che porta un numero più piccolo, 39) calzano meglio. Probabilmente dipende sia dalla misura sia dalle preferenze personali. Nel complesso la qualità è buona, ma la vestibilità potrebbe non soddisfare tutti, soprattutto chi cerca calzini sportivi molto aderenti. Considerando anche la fascia di prezzo, consiglio di valutare bene le proprie esigenze prima dell’acquisto. Nel complesso restano comunque un buon prodotto.

author: Zero Signal
title: Way better than tube socks in the winter
content: I had to travel for work a couple of weeks back and ended up taking a long train ride. I was sitting next to the door so I'd get a blast of cold air at every station. It wouldn't have been so bad except that I was wearing a set of uninsulated work boots and we were in the middle of a cold spell. That, combined with having to sit for 2+ hours at a stretch, meant my feet got COLD on that train ride (and the ride back, too). After that minor ordeal, I decided to buy some winter socks. I spent a fair amount of time looking at reviews and settled on these. They arrived a couple of days later and, after a wash, I tried a pair on. They're thicker than the typical tube socks I normally wear, and they're noticeably warmer. They won't keep your feet warm in REALLY cold weather, especially not in the uninsulated boots I normally wear, but that kind of weather calls for lined boots and wool socks. For the kind of (cold) winter we've been having, these are perfect. They're warmer and more comfortable than tube socks, but still not too warm to wear in an office setting. I've used thick Wigwam socks before and they were phenomenal in really cold weather, but my feet would roast indoors or in a car. These are a good balance for my typical days. I'm about to order another 5 pairs of these. That way I can always have some ready to go even when I get behind on laundry.

content: Les six paires de chaussettes sont livrées roulées dans un sachet plastique. content: Great quality socks! They're a nice durable, tightly woven cotton, and very stretchy, true to size. I really appreciate that they have 2 separate sizes, including one for smaller feet (5-8). Nun mal kurz angezogen empfinde ich die Socken als eher fest und doch auch irgendwie eng anliegend am Fuß und Knöchel. Ich habe die Socken dann gewaschen bei 40 Grad und im Schongang getrocknet. Da das Material aus 42% Baumwolle, 43% Acrylfaser, 10% Polyester, 5% Elastan besteht würde ich in Zukunft nicht wärmer waschen sonder Hygienespüler zusätzlich nutzen. Nach dem Trocknen im Schongang waren die Socken genauso wie sie angekommen sind, somit nicht eingelaufen. Auch die Farbe ist so wie vor dem waschen. Ich habe die Socken dann zunächst für einen längeren Spaziergang mit dem Hund getestet und nicht gleich zur Arbeit ( ich arbeite in einem kalten Bereich ). Der Test war so genau richtig!! Ich empfinde die Socken im allgemeinen als etwas zu eng und ich habe im Fußbereich ganz normale Maße. Leider war eine wirklich angenehme Wärmeentwicklung nicht fühlbar. Es war eher so das die wohlige Wärme ausblieb dafür meine Füße aber zu schwitzen begannen und das war eher ein unangenehmes Gefühl. Ich würde diese Socken also besser nicht über Stunden zur Arbeit tragen. Die Verarbeitung der Socken ist jedoch wirklich sehr gut. Da gibt es keine Nähte die drücken oder Ähnliches. Auch der Preis ist für 5 Paar Socken Moderat. Ich kann jedoch nicht mehr als 3 Sterne vergeben aufgrund der guten Verarbeitung.

CONTRAS: -Poco algodón en comparación con productos similares. -El precio actual de venta de los seis pares (26,99€) me resulta excesivo, sobre todo porque hay calcetines deportivos de marcas especializadas mundialmente conocidas a un precio similar. EN DEFINITIVA: Los calcetines cumplen para práctica deportiva de andar por casa, no se me ocurriría usarlos en una maratón. Hemos probado en un 10k y aguantan bien, pero no tanto en tirada larga (antes de la media ya empezaron a molestar). Para el gimnasio, para alguna pachanguita, para caminar,... para lo demás no puede competir con marcas especializadas; si, además, cuestan lo mismo o incluso más que unos de marca, no le encuentro un atractivo mayor.

I think they should be five pairs for £21, not three.

author: Cheryl Rainfield
title: Soft, comfortable, stay up when walking fast & for long periods ONLY for a few uses
content: UPDATE: After repeated uses on the trail I walk on, the socks stopped staying up. I had to repeatedly stop, take my foot out of my shoe, and pull the socks back up. The heel kept slipping down, which if I left it could cause blisters--and this wasn't after a LOT of uses. These "invisible" socks are comfortable and actually stay on because of the silicone grips in the inner heel. I recently bought a number of different pairs of invisible socks for the summer when walking on the trail but the heels kept slipping off of one or the other of my feet. These socks stay on my feet, don't slip down, are very comfortable, and you can't see that you're wearing socks. The set comes with six pairs of "invisible" socks: two black, two gray, and two white, rolled up neatly with a label and in a branded semi-transparent pouch. They look good enough to give as a gift or to get for yourself. They are made of 80% cotton, 17% polyester, 3% spandex. The heels and toes are reinforced. And the inner silicone grips really work, and I didn't even notice them sensory-wise. I like these socks for the summer when it is so hot out and I don't feel like wearing socks but I need to not get blisters from my running shoes. These socks are perfect for that; they just cover my feet, and they stay up really well with the silicone grips inside the heel. I didn't even notice the silicone grips to touch; I only noticed them afterwards because I wondered why they'd stayed up when other similar socks hadn't and I looked onside. Because they are made mostly of cotton they are also very breathable and soft and comfortable. I wore these socks while walking quickly and hard on the trail inside my running shoes and I walked for more than an hour. The socks stayed firmly in place and were very comfortable. They do say to wash in cold water and tumble dry at a low heat, I'm guessing because of the silicone grips. The silicone grips make these socks stand out to me in a good way.

content: Ich habe seit Jahren!!! nicht mehr einen so perfekt sitzenden BH gehabt. Er hat unten am Körbchen eine extra Naht, die wie ein Bügel funktioniert. Ich hab eine M bestellt mit einer Unterbrustweite von 84 cm und eine Brustweite von 94 cm und es passt wie angegossen. Ich bin total begeistert! Nachtrag dreiviertel Jahr später: Ich habe mir nochmal einen in beige bestellt, da die 2 schwarzen, die ich bereits hatte schon ausgleiert stark waren. Vor allem das Unterbrustband ist deutlich weiter geworden. Fairerweise muss ich dazu sagen, dass ich die BHs nie per Hand gewaschen habe, sondern meistens auf 40 °C mit anderer schwarzer Kleidung und manchmal auch mit Weichspüler.

author: Anthony Emmons
title: Different but comfortable; Slightly less breathable
content: I acquired these socks through Vine. I was interested in the product as basically everyday socks to wear with sneakers regardless of the activity. Compared to my typical name-brand socks, these took some getting used to. When I first put them on, I only then realized these socks have non-slip rubber pads in the back to prevent the sock from slipping off the back of your foot. I didn't experience any slipping off at all, so while I suppose the rubber pad is effective, I'm still getting used to them. These socks do feel tighter on the front of my foot. I typically wear a size 10/10.5 shoe. I believe that puts me on the smaller end of the size range for these socks, 10-13, so I am sort of surprised at how snug they feel. I also find these socks to be less breathable. The first pair I wore, I really noticed it. Just wearing them with sneakers, sitting and playing cards for a couple hours, my feet felt damp in my shoes. The second time I wore them, I didn't notice it as much. While I have yet to wear these while working out or engaging in any strenuous activity, I anticipate needing to change socks soon after such activity. Overall, while they might be a little snug and less breathable than I am used to, they are a good no-show sock.

content: Pros: Comfort and Breathability: These socks live up to their claim of being comfortable. The cotton blend feels soft against the skin and provides decent breathability. My feet didn't feel overly sweaty or constricted even after a full day of wear. Durability: The socks feel well-made and sturdy. After several washes, they’ve retained their shape and haven't shown any significant signs of wear. Versatility: The design is versatile enough to be worn with dress shoes for business settings or with sneakers for more casual occasions. The solid colors are classic and easy to pair with various outfits. Stain Resistance (Claim): While I didn't intentionally try to stain them, I did notice that minor spills and dirt seemed to brush off relatively easily. They definitely seem to resist stains a bit better than standard cotton socks, making them a good option for busy days or situations where you might be prone to spills. Value for Money: A 6-pair pack offers good value, especially considering the claimed benefits. If they hold up well over time, they'll be a great investment for your sock drawer. Fit: The socks fit true to size and provided good support without being too tight. Cons: Material Composition: The exact cotton blend wasn't specified. While they feel comfortable, knowing the exact percentage of cotton and other materials would be helpful for those with sensitivities or preferences for specific fabrics. Stain Resistance (Limitations): While they are stain resistant, they aren't stain proof. You'll still want to wash them promptly if you get a significant stain on them. Thickness: While the thickness is good for versatile uses, some might find them a bit too thin for very cold weather or activities requiring extra cushioning. Overall: The CLOSEMATE Men's Socks are a solid choice for anyone looking for comfortable, durable, and versatile socks for everyday wear. They offer a good balance of comfort, style, and practicality, and the stain-resistant feature is a welcome bonus. While they might not be perfect for extreme conditions or those with very specific material preferences, they're a reliable and affordable option for most men's sock needs. Rating: 4 out of 5 stars. author: SMB
title: Would-be decent low-cut/no show socks, loose/skipped threads*, soft/comfy, questionable longevity
content: These are would-be decent ultra low-cut/no-show socks that appear to be well made at first glance; however, there are loose/skipped threads on just about ALL of 'em (i.e. 5 out of 6 pairs), which are beyond disappointing to say the least. They're fairly soft and comfortable although I would've very much preferred 100% cotton (or at least higher cotton content) instead. They are also slightly thinner (see below) than anticipated, which is a bit of a bummer. They are made of 80% cotton with 17% polyester and 3% spandex for those who care. ✘ Note that spandex (and to a certain degree polyester) is used NOT only to reduce cost for obvious reasons (i.e. cheaper material) but it's also to reduce the overall fabric required because it stretches which (again) reduces the overall cost (i.e. kill 2 birds with 1 stone). Just imagine a size 6 can fit someone that needs size 10 (such as these). Of course, one of the downside for obvious reason is that these would also appear to be thinner for those who are at the larger end of the spectrum since they are stretched (to the limit). At the end of the day, it's all about cost cutting which I understand but I don't appreciate it if it negatively affects the performance of the products. ### ≡ Value All things considered, these are would-be decent ultra low-cut/no show socks that are not well-made with skipped/loose threads on 5 out of 6 pairs, which is just beyond disappointing; however, they are fairly soft and comfortable given the circumstance. They are somewhat reasonably priced at $20 (for 6x pairs) for what they provide and their overall quality (or the lack thereof rather) and comfort. Their longevity remains to be seen although they are likely not gonna last long based on what I've seen so far. Your mileage might vary.

title: Buoni materiali e traspirazione, ma attenzione alle taglie che vestono piccole
content: Questi calzini CLOSEMATE da corsa (confezione da 6 paia) sono realizzati con una composizione dichiarata di 85% cotone, circa 12% nylon e 3% materiale elastico, una combinazione che li rende nel complesso comodi e abbastanza traspiranti. 🧵 Materiali e comfort Il cotone è predominante e si percepisce subito al tatto: i calzini risultano morbidi e piacevoli da indossare. La struttura è corta, con altezza sotto il malleolo, quindi adatta a scarpe sportive e sneakers. La zona della pianta presenta una trama rinforzata con piccoli rombi, che migliora leggermente l’ammortizzazione e allo stesso tempo mantiene una buona traspirazione grazie alle micro-aree più traforate. Nel complesso risultano: • abbastanza traspiranti • elastici il giusto, quindi restano ben aderenti al piede • adatti per camminate, palestra leggera o uso quotidiano 👣 Vestibilità Durante l’utilizzo rimangono abbastanza stabili e non tendono a scivolare nel piede, grazie alla presenza della componente elastica e del supporto nella zona dell’arco. ⚠️ Problema principale: la taglia Il limite più evidente riguarda la vestibilità delle taglie, che risultano decisamente sottostimate. Avevo acquistato la taglia più grande per mio figlio che porta 45–46, ma i calzini risultano più adatti a un 42 circa. Di fatto li utilizzerò io per passeggiate e attività all’aperto più tranquille. Per questo motivo consiglio di tenere conto che le taglie vestono piccole, soprattutto se si hanno piedi grandi. 💰 Prezzo Il prezzo non è particolarmente competitivo rispetto ad altri prodotti simili, soprattutto considerando il problema di vestibilità. ________________________________________ 🔚 Conclusione Calzini nel complesso comodi, con buona traspirazione e materiali discreti, ma penalizzati da taglie che vestono più piccole del previsto e dal prezzo non completamente competitivo

title: Not sure these are truly 80% cotton...
content: These socks arrive in a box, beautifully rolled up in satisfying rows, looking very much gift-like. Feeling the material, it feels surprisingly synthetic for socks that are said to be 80% cotton. It feels slick, silky, very smooth and very stretchy. And looking at the interior under a light, the fabric looks shiny / glittery which synthetic plastic-based fabrics can do sometimes. They're a little shiny on the outside too. So based on feel alone, these don't feel very cottony to me. Granted, they have 17% polyester in them so maybe that's feeling more dominant for some reason even though the cotton is meant to be in a higher proportion. Having said that, they do feel silky smooth with very fine thread which is a pleasant sensation. In terms of thickness I'd say they are medium to thin. They are not very warming. In terms of sizing, they are very versatile. I got the size 9-12 for my husband, but tried them on myself (me being a size 6) and they fit me very comfortably too, and feel snug despite me being petite! They stretched to fit him as well though were a little tighter on him. In terms of quality, they look and feel like good quality. I did deduct stars just because I'm left feeling very dubious about the cotton content of these being 80% as described. For a cotton rich sock I'd give it 3 stars. For polyester socks though I'd give them 5 stars.

title: Calcetines cómodos
content: Son 6 pares de calcetines unisex de tiro bajo para deporte acolchados, transpirables y antiampollas. Cada pack está disponibles en S, L y M, y cada uno de estos pack se adapta a 4 tallas. Pedí la M, que comprende las tallas 39, 40, 41 y 42. Según su publicidad, su composición es 85% algodón, 12% nailon y 3% elastano, haciendo que sean suaves, elásticos y antideslizante, mejorando el agarre y evitando que el calcetín se gire o se deslice hacia la puntera, sin embargo, en mi caso, será mi talla coincide con el extremo de la M, durante el día se me desliza hacia abajo, poco pero se desliza algo. Igual debería haber elegido la L. No todos tenemos los pies iguales, aunque la longitud de la planta sea la misma, y el hecho de abarcar tantas tallas en un mismo calcetín acentúa el inconveniente que no a todos los compradores les coincidan adecuadamente las distintas zonas del pie, fundamentalmente el talón. Los calcetines lleva un tejido transpirable y la puntera, el talón y la planta acolchados, reduciendo la fricción y, por tanto, evitando posibles ampollas o irritaciones durante su uso prolongado o alto nivel de estrés. Además, parecen resistente, el tiempo dirá. El alto porcentaje de algodón y el grosor los hace ideales no sólo para el deportes, sino también para otras actividades, además del uso diario e intensivo. Un detalle interesante es que el vendedor se compromete a reemplazar sin coste alguno el producto si el comprador observa cualquier defecto de fabricación. A pesar de todas las bondades que tienen los calcetines, el precio me parece algo alto, sin embargo, puedes probar y si te se adaptan perfectamente a tu pie y te sientes muy cómodos con ellos, el precio puede pasar a un segundo plano.

title: Morbido, confortevole ma veste piccolo
content: Qualità piuttosto buona per questo reggiseno senza cuciture e senza ferretto: tessuto morbido, imbottitura discreta e rimuovibile, chiusura a gancetti regolabile con estensione aggiuntiva in dotazione. Anche il packaging è molto curato, tanto da farlo sembrare un prodotto d'alta gamma. Ma non lo è. Innanzi tutto, le taglie non corrispondono ai nostri standard. Io ho preso una XL perchè porto una 4 coppa D, ma si è rilevata molto più piccola del consueto. Il tessuto è molto elastico e alla fine si adatta comunque alla conformazione del seno, ma è evidente che le misure sono differenti. Anche la circonferenza del sottoseno non è soddisfacente: nelle taglie più grandi come la mia si rivela più larga del previsto. Insomma non c'è equilibrio tra circonferenza seno e sottoseno. Le spalline sono adeguate ma nelle taglie forti sarebbe consigliabile applicare quelle un po' più larghe per non segnare troppo la pelle. Le stecche laterali, infine, sono pressoché inutili: il sostegno nel mio caso è quasi nullo. Forse è più indicato per un seno più piccolo che non superi la 3. In conclusione, una mezza delusione. Grandi aspettative, anche perchè conosco il marchio e finora non mi aveva deluso, ma in questo caso poca sostanza.

title: CALZINI SPORTIVI INVERNALI IN TESSUTO TRASPIRANTE E TERMOISOLANTE
content: I calzini Closemate sono un accessorio d’abbigliamento fondamentale per il trekking in quanto assicurano comfort e freschezza durante le camminate. Queste calze sportive prodotte in Cina si caratterizzano per la bellezza dell’indumento e la tonalità della colorazione grigia chiara. Il capo in pregiata lana merino oltre a mantenere i piedi caldi non irrita la pelle risultando davvero comodo da indossare per le escursioni all’aria aperta grazie alla particolare conformazione della suola in spugna ispessita in grado di assorbire gli urti, oltre alla punta senza cuciture. Sta di fatto che la specifica composizione del materiale li rende morbidi e traspiranti, prevenendo la formazione di cattivi odori per tutto il giorno attraverso la particolare lavorazione del tessuto e l’esclusiva area di ventilazione a maglia. Infine l’esclusivo design ergonomico del polsino ne permette la perfetta aderenza alla caviglia evitando scivolamenti. Per la verità una volta indossati ne ho apprezzato la vestibilità regolare con il polsino che non stringe, ma soprattutto il materiale di qualità con imbottiture nelle zone del piede a maggiore sollecitazione durante i movimenti. Alla luce di tali considerazioni mi sento senz’altro di consigliare queste calze sicure e comode per chi è appassionato di sport all’aperto, tenuto conto delle proprietà traspiranti, ma soprattutto del buon rapporto qualità prezzo e delle caratteristiche del tessuto in spugna perfetto per la stagione invernale.

title: Very good, but expensive if you don’t need the extra grip
content: These socks are very comfortable indeed. The size I ordered was 5-9; I take 8, and they fitted perfectly. Someone with feet smaller than a 7 would find them loose. The material is a good combination of cotton for coolness and breathability, nylon and polyester for strength and spandex for stretch. Although they are cool in summer, they are thick enough for winter wear, and good enough quality to last well. I don’t do any of the “high-intensity” sports mentioned; I do pilates in socks, so these would give extra grip for the standing exercises. They also produce an effect like slipper socks, if you prefer to walk around in socks at home, and would be safer on smooth floors than ordinary socks. The grip isn’t rubber, so these would be fine as everyday socks. However, if that’s all you want you would buy something cheaper. There is some confusion on drying. The description implies tumble-drying is OK, and the packaging says “tumble dry with high temp should be avoided” and “do not tumble dry”. None of the materials should suffer from tumble-drying, so I suspect it’s OK if done with care.

title: Materialverarbeitung super, Größe nicht korrekt!
content: Die von Closemate stammenden Sneakersocken werden herstellerseitig in einem wiederverschließbaren, aus Kunststoff bestehenden, Beutel geliefert (der Umwelt zuliebe wäre hierzu eine nachhaltigere Alternative wünschenswert). Bestellt habe ich die Socken in der Größe M, so dass sie bei Frauen als passend bei einer 37,5-43 angegeben wurden. Ich trage normalerweise eine 39, oft kommt aber auch eine 38 für mich in Frage. Die Closemate-Socken fallen diesbezüglich zu groß aus, so dass eine ideale Passform leider nicht gegeben ist. Sie sollten also, je nach vorhandener Größe, kleiner eingekauft oder herstellerseitig neu deklariert werden. Die Materialverarbeitung kann sich insgesamt sehen lassen, Mängel sind hierbei nicht aufgefallen. Die Socken bestehen aus Baumwolle, Polyester, Nylon und Elasthan/ Spandex. Den jeweils prozentualen Anteil habe ich nicht in Erfahrung bringen können. Pflegehinweise sind vorhanden, aber nicht vollständig ausgewiesen. Gewaschen werden dürfen die Sneakersocken in der Maschine, Temperaturangaben fehlen. Es klappt bei 30°C und 40°C, allerdings neigen die Socken zum Pilling. Um das Material zu schonen empfiehlt es sich daher, sie auf links zu waschen und ein Wäschesäckchen zu verwenden, sowie ausschließlich der Schonwaschgang (mit einem Feinwaschmittel). In den Trockner sollten die Socken nicht kommen. Auf Weichspüler ist möglichst zu verzichten. Diese Punkte sollten den Pilling-Effekt deutlich minimieren. Bleiche ist tabu. Zur chemischen Reinigung sind keine Informationen hinterlegt. Bei Socken kommt es aber auch in der Regel nicht vor, sie professionell reinigen lassen zu wollen. Auf der Haut fühlt sich das Material angenehm an, dahingehend gibt es nichts zu beanstanden. Mehr als 3 Sterne kann ich aufgrund der insgesamt aufgefallenen Mängel nicht vergeben!

content: Bueno, la verdad es que esperaba que estos calcetines fuesen un auténtico escándalo, dado todo lo que había escuchado sobre la marca Closemate. Pero al final, me encontré con el clásico trío de calcetines deportivos. No es que sean malos, pero tampoco me impresionaron. Calzo un 47 y pedí la talla L. Me quedan bien, lo cual es un alivio porque a veces encontrar calcetines que se ajusten correctamente puede ser un desafío. Son suaves y cómodos al ponerlos, y no tuve problemas de rozaduras durante mis entrenamientos. Pero eso es básicamente lo mínimo que esperas de unos calcetines deportivos, ¿no? Después de algunos lavados, ya empezaron a mostrar signos de desgaste, algo que no esperaba dado el precio. Por 24,99 € el trío, creo que es un coste bastante elevado. Comparándolos con los calcetines de Decathlon que tengo, que cuestan mucho menos, realmente no veo una diferencia significativa en calidad. De hecho, los de Decathlon han aguantado mejor con el tiempo. Aspectos Positivos: Suaves y cómodos Se ajustan bien a pies grandes (talla 47 en mi caso) Aspectos Negativos: Precio elevado en comparación con marcas como Decathlon Durabilidad cuestionable después de varios lavados No justifica el costo elevado con una diferencia significativa en calidad En resumen, estos calcetines Closemate están bien, pero no ofrecen nada extraordinario que justifique su alto precio. Creo que me quedo con los de Decathlon por ahora.

title: Comfortable everyday socks that actually stay put.
content: I received the CLOSEMATE Athletic Running Ankle Socks in the six pair pack (2 black, 2 white, 2 light grey, size large) and they have quickly become some of the most comfortable athletic socks in my drawer. From the first wear it was clear these were designed with real everyday activity in mind. The cushioning is noticeable but not bulky, giving a soft layer under the heel and forefoot that makes walking, running, or long hours on your feet feel easier. It adds just enough padding to absorb impact without making shoes feel tight. The arch support is another feature that stands out. There is a gentle compression through the midfoot that helps the sock stay in place and keeps it from sliding around inside the shoe. Even after several hours of activity they stay positioned exactly where they should, which helps prevent the bunching that can cause irritation during workouts or long walks. Breathability is also very good. The material feels lightweight and allows airflow so feet stay comfortable instead of overheated. After a full day of use they still feel dry and fresh rather than damp like some thicker athletic socks. The low cut design with the heel tab is a nice touch as well. The tab makes them easy to pull on and protects the back of the ankle from rubbing against the shoe collar. With six pairs included, the overall value is excellent. The comfort, support, and durability make this a very practical set whether they are used for running, gym workouts, or everyday wear. They feel well made and hold their shape nicely after washing, which makes them a reliable addition to any rotation of athletic socks.

I am UK size 8 but ordered the larger size (9-12) as this fabric can shrink if subjected to a little heat so I assume these will fit slightly better after washing a few times. These ankle socks are made from; 80% Viscose Derived from Bamboo, 10% Cotton, 7% Nylon, 3% Spandex. They certainly feel stretchy but do retain their original shape after wearing and washing. I am not one to spend a huge amount of time washing and drying clothes according to their care labels and tend to use a mixed items programme on a low temperature then either air dry everything if it’s a good drying day, or tumble dry on low heat if not. These socks survived the latter process without much shrinkage at all and still fit well so I hope this remains true for future washes. Overall, I am happy with the socks but only time will tell if they last.

title: Calcetines muy cómodos
content: Se trata de 6 pares de calcetines de color negro unisex de tiro bajo para deporte acolchados, transpirables y antiampollas. Cada pack está disponibles en S, L y M, y cada uno de estos pack se adapta a 4 tallas. Pedí la M, que comprende las tallas 39, 40, 41 y 42. Anteriormente pedí de color blanco y me gustó el producto, lo que no me gustó fue el precio, y me sigue sin gustar, pero la calidad del producto en este caso prima sobre el coste del mismo. Igual que en los anteriores, según la publicidad, su composición es 85% algodón, 12% nailon y 3% elastano, lo cual permite que sean sean suaves, elásticos y antideslizante, mejorando el agarre y evitando que el calcetín se gire o se deslice hacia la puntera, sin embargo, en mi caso se me desliza hacia abajo si lo usas durante toda una jornada, no para hacer deporte, sino para el uso cotidiano. En cualquier caso, de momento, no he encontrado otros que no deslicen, y como estos son cómodos, soy feliz con ellos. Son transpirables y parecen resistentes, la puntera, el talón y la planta están acolchados, mermando la fricción con la piel, lo cual evita problemas de rozaduras. El diseño de estos calcetines los hace ideales no sólo para el deportes, sino también para otras actividades, además del uso diario e intensivo. A pesar de las muchas bondades de los calcetines, el precio penaliza, sin embargo, un plus es que el vendedor te reemplazar sin coste alguno el producto si observas cualquier defecto de fabricación.

author: Melissa
title: Millennial Core: 90s sock energy
content: These are pretty great, basic white socks. For a millennial, they’re a total flashback. I distinctly remember owning a massive pair of thick purple scrunch socks that lasted into middle school. Wild! These aren’t quite as durable as the authentic early 90s ones, but they’re definitely comfortable. The bottom half is tightly knit, super soft, and has a subtle arch support. The soles are thicker and better quality than I expected. The upper scrunch portion is loosely knit, which gives them great stretch, breathability, and that classic slouch. That said, they won’t stay up if you’re planning to wear them tall. I fully acknowledge I'm not a foot model and my flat feet give me cankles, but I've demonstrated as best I can what they look like in various shoes up, worn up and slouched. They’re very, very soft, and I appreciate that they’re 85% cotton. However, I usually buy socks in 6-packs for $14.99, so this trend doesn’t quite justify the price for me. Not unreasonable by most people’s standards, but not high enough quality for me to rave. I’d rate these around 3.5 stars.

author: Diabolik
title: Chaussettes de sport confortables et bien renforcées
content: J’ai testé ces chaussettes de sport sur plusieurs activités (course, marche prolongée et séances de training), et globalement elles offrent un bon équilibre entre confort, maintien et durabilité. La matière en coton est assez douce au toucher et donne une sensation agréable au pied. Les chaussettes sont clairement épaisses, avec un bon niveau de rembourrage, ce qui se ressent particulièrement au niveau du talon, de l’avant-pied et de la semelle. Pendant la marche ou la course, cet amorti absorbe correctement les impacts et limite les frottements, ce qui rend les sessions assez confortables même sur des durées longues. Le maintien est également un point positif. La compression au niveau de la voûte plantaire apporte un bon soutien sans être trop serrée, et la texture légèrement renforcée sous le pied améliore la stabilité dans la chaussure. J’ai aussi apprécié le bord élastique qui garde bien la chaussette en place, sans qu’elle glisse ou tourne, même pendant des mouvements répétés ou des entraînements un peu intensifs. Au niveau respirabilité, il y a des zones en maille sur le dessus et les côtés du pied, ce qui aide un peu à la circulation de l’air. Cependant, comme les chaussettes sont assez épaisses, j’ai trouvé que la matière peut faire transpirer assez facilement, surtout pendant les séances intenses ou par temps chaud. L’humidité s’évacue moins rapidement que sur des modèles plus techniques en fibres synthétiques fines, donc elles sont plus adaptées aux saisons fraîches ou aux entraînements modérés. En termes de durabilité, elles semblent solides. Les zones renforcées au talon et aux orteils tiennent bien après plusieurs lavages, et je n’ai pas remarqué de déformation particulière. Elles gardent leur forme générale et leur élasticité reste correcte dans le temps. En résumé, ce sont des chaussettes confortables, épaisses et bien structurées, parfaites pour le sport léger à modéré ou un usage quotidien. Leur seul vrai point faible est une respirabilité moyenne, qui peut entraîner un peu de transpiration lors d’efforts intenses, mais le confort global reste très satisfaisant.

title: Well-made Warm Socks, but Tight and Uncomfortable to Wear
content: Buying socks online has been hit-or-miss for me, and the same thing goes for the Closemate Thick Thermal Mens Socks. They are well-made, and definitely do the job of keeping your feet warm in cold weather, but they suffer from the same problem that many other sock manufacturers do. They run small and don't fit well. When you first put them on, you can feel how tight they are on your feet. After several hours of wearing them, they actually start to feel constrictive and uncomfortable. You can feel the relief when you take them off. Since this is an imported product, it may have been made with smaller people from overseas in mind. But if you're going to sell clothing to the US market, an accommodation needs to be made for the larger-sized people that live here, footwear included. I'm sure it's just a sizing issue, but since these are listed as size 12-15 shoes, maybe a plus version might be helpful for the American market. If you have smaller feet, the Closemate Thick Thermal Mens Socks may just be for you. But as for me, I'll have to keep looking for a warm pair of socks that actually fit.

title: Calzini da running nella media — confortevoli, ma il grip antiscivolo delude 🧦👟
content: Calzini da corsa CLOSEMATE, set da 6 paia in cotone 85%, con supporto per l'arco plantare e grip antiscivolo, taglia 43-46, colore nero — prodotto che si presenta bene sulla carta ma che dal vivo lascia qualche dubbio 🤔. La confezione è ordinata, i calzini sono tutti uguali e ben accoppiati, niente di entusiasmante ma neanche di negativo a prima vista. Li ho ordinati perché avevo bisogno di un set di calzini tecnici da usare sia in palestra che nelle uscite di corsa, e un pacco da 6 paia nero in taglia 43-46 era esattamente quello che cercavo per rinnovare il cassetto senza spendere una fortuna 💪🏃. Il set include 6 paia identici, colore nero uniforme, taglia 43-46 che calza bene anche su piedi nella parte alta della scala 👣. L'85% di cotone si sente: il tessuto è morbido e piacevole sulla pelle, non graffia e non stringe in modo fastidioso. Lo spessore è medio, con una leggera ammortizzazione nella zona del tallone e della pianta 🦶. Il supporto per l'arco plantare è presente sotto forma di fasciatura elastica centrale — si percepisce, anche se non è particolarmente pronunciato. L'uso principale è quello da running e palestra, ma la vestibilità comoda li rende ottimi anche per una giornata lavorativa lunga in piedi 🏭🏃. Il cotone li rende più adatti a sessioni moderate che a corse intense sotto il sole — per il running estivo ad alta intensità un tessuto più sintetico sarebbe probabilmente più indicato 🌞. Il problema principale è il grip antiscivolo: le gommature sulla suola ci sono ma sono piuttosto sottili e dopo qualche lavaggio si sentono pochissimo sotto la scarpa 😕. La traspirabilità è discreta ma non eccezionale — con il cotone dominante il piede tende a scaldarsi un po' durante gli sforzi prolungati 🌡️. Le cuciture della punta sono piatte e non danno fastidio, questo va riconosciuto ✅. ✅ Morbidi, corti al punto giusto, cuciture piatte, taglia precisa, prezzo conveniente per 6 paia, nero versatile 🖤 ❌ Grip antiscivolo quasi irrilevante, traspirabilità limitata per sessioni intense, supporto plantare poco pronunciato 😕

title: Nice socks but far too tight around even my slim lower legs
content: This review is for the Closemate Mens Grip Socks Anti-Slip Socks for Football Soccer Basketball Trekking Yoga Running With Anti-Blister Pads 3 Pairs (3WhiteGrey, 5-9) £14.99 at the time of review Comfortable to wear and they stay up right through a day of wearing. My biggest criticism is that the socks are far too tight and leave serious indentations on my lower legs. The elasticated top can be stretched which helps a little, but the weave is so tight the pattern leaves indentations on my legs. I have quite thin legs so if your lower legs are bigger, then you might not even get these to fit over your calves. My legs just above my ankles measure 21cms in diameter. They washed at 20deg without any problems and I also tumble dried them to see if they shrank, and they didn’t, so that is good news. The grippy soles give you some grip on laminated floors but weren’t too much to be awkward to walk in. My feet don’t tend to slide around in socks when playing sports, and these were no different for me. I do like them, but the compression issue is enough of a problem that makes me deduct a star. I also think they are a touch on the expensive side as well, so that loses another point. Sadly, there is no WOW factor that makes me want to up the rating, so 3 stars from me. If you have more solid lower legs than me, you might not even be able to pull them up, and even if you did, the compression marks will be even worse.

author: Claretwhine
title: Good value, but may not suit if you take a wide foot shoe fitting
content: I'm always a bit dubious about anything that is sold as 'universal' or 'one size fits all' because, taking an extra wide shoe size 9 fitting it's hard to get comfortable socks and shoes. Hence i've never bothered trying to be fashionable by wearing trainer socks, so was interested to trial these Closemate ones, described as being unisex and available in a 9-12 size, which I thought might suit me. I received a pack of 6 black socks, each rolled in a paper sleeve and contained in a small zip lock storage bag. The label recommends cold water washing and air dry only, but in reality most people will throw the socks into a washing machine on a low temperature setting. It will be interesting to see how they wear after a few washes. The socks have reinforced stitching at toe ends and heel tops, plus the heels have 3 bands of silicone gel heel grips which are supposed to act as an anti-slip measure. Wearing the socks I didn't feel the strips at all, but am yet to do any serious distance to test whether they rub on my heels or become detached after a few outings. Overall, I feel they socks are good value for the price of £12.99 for 6 pairs and the material and stitching seems to be of good quality. My only issue so far is on the comfort fitting. Although claimed to be a size 9-12 fitting (probably fine for most people) i'm constantly aware of of my big toes feeling pinched. To be fair, i'll try wearing the socks around the house and see whether they stretch a bit before venturing out where any serious walking is required. If not, the socks will be given to another family member with 'normal' sized feet.

La parte lungo la gamba è più morbida e questo permette alla calza di poterla arrotolare. Questo tipo di calzettoni mi piacciono molto perché possono essere usati per un tocco di stile un po' più particolare adatto soprattutto ai teenager? Secondo me questo tipo di spessore è adatto ad una normalissima sneakers. Pratica per la quotidianità e fashion per uno stile personalizzato. Per quanto riguarda il lavaggio è perfetto, l'elasticità viene mantenuta anche dopo aver usato l'asciugatrice.

content: I’m looking for socks that I can wear around the house especially on slippery floors. I sometimes use hospital socks with their streaks of rubber for this purpose. content: These aren’t the best grippy socks you’ll find at this price. They’re certainly not bad, but they’re a solid four star option. The grey grippy pads underneath aren’t visually very prominent, even compared to the product photos. They have a reasonable amount of grip on them, but they don’t pack quite as much rubbery stickiness as some other brands, and they seem to rely more on having a coarse fabric material than the rubbery effect. The stickiness is arranged in quite a narrow channel down the centre of the foot, and if you’re overpronating or in the process of landing awkwardly due to a slip that’s already started, there’s a chance the pads are going to miss the ground altogether. I got a 9 - 12 set, and the sizing is good, though with size 10.5 feet I maybe expected just a little more room, and if I had size 12 feet I might be moaning about getting yet another pair of socks that claims to fit but doesn’t. For the current asking price of fifteen quid for three pairs, there are other brands that offer better value on this site, but these are OK and perfectly wearable.

author: ChiTownGuy
title: Comfort Meets Durability
content: I ordered these socks because I was looking for a comfortable solution for daily office wear. My dress shirts and trousers felt undone without socks that could handle a long day without slipping or bunching. I hoped to find something soft enough to wear from morning meetings through after work dinners while keeping my feet cool and dry. The fabric blend feels pleasantly soft against the skin from the first wear. Breathability is strong enough to manage day long wear under dress shoes, and the spandex adds enough give to prevent any pinching. I appreciate the reinforced areas at the heel and toe which have shown no signs of thinning after multiple wash cycles. The seam at the toe remains low profile and keeps irritation at bay. After about a dozen washes, I noticed a small amount of fuzz at the cuff but the shape and fit remain largely unchanged. The fit reaches mid-calf without feeling tight and they stay in place without leaving marks on my skin. I wore them with leather oxfords, loafers and even a pair of sneakers and never felt a need to adjust them. The mix of solid tones and subtle patterns matched well with dress pants, chinos and even dark denim. I have tried budget multipacks from big box retailers and higher priced designer socks before, and these landed comfortably between the two. They cost about three dollars per pair which feels fair for the comfort and durability on offer. Cheaper pairs often lose elasticity after a few wears and premium labels can charge double without a noticeable gain. In this case I feel the balance of price and quality is just right for most use cases. In my experience these socks deliver on comfort and longevity without breaking the bank. They are best suited for anyone who spends long hours on their feet or needs a reliable sock for professional dress. If you want a simple well-made option that packs nicely and holds up to wash and wear these are an excellent pick. I plan to reorder when these wear out.

author: pete
title: "CLOSEMATE" 30% Merino Wool Socks
content: These are good quality, well made socks but I think they could be so much better if the "Merino Wool" content was about 80% instead of just 30%. I appreciate that these days, socks rely on a certain amount of non biodegradable materials such as elastane, polyester and nylon to give them stretch, but I think that if you are to call a pair of socks "Merino Wool", and charge £20.99 for 3 pairs, then you would at least expect the "Merino Wool" content to be above 50%. Being as "Merino Wool" is a lovely soft material that derives from Spanish sheep and is more expensive, I can see why "CLOSEMATE" have chosen to limit it to 30% in the mix of fibres, but I think that if I were to pay £7.00 for a pair of socks I would be expecting a sock that is not manufactured from 70% man made materials which are much cheaper than "Merino Wool". Good Quality, well made socks, but not enough wool content for the price.

title: Calzini comodi ma meno caldi del previsto
content: Ho potuto provare questi calzini in cotone pettinato blu adatti per lavoro ma non solo. La confezione ben curata contiene 6 paia di calzini dello stesso colore scelto. Il tessuto è fatto da 80% di cotone che permette una buona traspirazione e poiché non sono sottili, dovrebbero tenere caldo il piede durante l'inverno. Oltre al cotone troviamo anche 17% di poliestere che rendere i calzini più robusti e quindi una maggiore resistenza all'usura. Infine grazie alla presenza del 3% di elastan i calzini sono più elastici permettendo di tenere ben aderenti gli stessi e quindi un maggior confort. Al tatto il tessuto si presenta morbido con una buona trama e robustezza dei calzini in particolar modo ai talloni, e una volta indossati danno un'ottima aderenza, senza rischio di allentamenti. La dimensione scelta è conforme al piede e grazie alla elasticità del tessuto copre anche un'ampia fascia di taglie. Dopo una giornata d'uso posso dire che li ho trovati abbastanza comodi, ma poichè i calzini non sono sottili e la presenza di una piccola parte sintetica, mi hanno lasciato i piedi leggermente più umidi e quindi meno caldi del previsto. author: LoveTableTopGames
title: Did and did not work for me
content: We ordered the Medium 6-10 and I'm a men's 9-9.5 size. Purpose of socks: Socks provide your feet with protection, moisture control, temperature regulation, and comfort. Socks provide protection by adding a layer between the shoe and your foot, easing friction and preventing blisters. + Socks fit well and are stretched without feeling like a compression sock. Heel is halfway covered and top of food is halfway covered. + These are no-show, unlike many "sports" sock no-shows. They look like I'm wearing shoes barefooted. Especially with athletic shoes and casual shoes that aren't low profile like a women's flats, these socks are hidden well. -- Top of foot is halfway covered. The less ideal part of this is that some shoes with a tongue or a athletic shoe that is a "sock" may rub the top of the foot and there won't be any protection. For instance, my Van's casual shoe (the ones I own and the ones I've tried on) the tongue has a tendency to press at the part of the foot between the food and the ankle. Without any protection, this equals rubbing and blisters. -- Heel is halfway covered. Different shoes have different heel cuts. Some are shaped creating a pocket for your heel to fit in, meaning there is a curve at the 3/4ths spot where the heel of the shoe curves back into the foot where your heel and ankle have an indention. This is where I got a blister after walking 3 miles with an athletic shoe with these socks. Other socks come higher and help protect that part of the heel. OVERALL: Truly no-show and works with female flats. But for casual and athletic shoes your mileage may vary as mine left blisters due to no coverage/protection.

author: Siobhan O'Leary
title: Super cushy, comfy and made with quality fabric
content: These are very comfortable socks and I'm glad that I decided to try them out. I wear shoes in a size 8 or sometimes 7 and a half and these socks come in sizes 5-8 or 8-11. Rather than risk the socks being too small, I decided to order them in size 8-11 and that size fit perfectly so if you wear a size 7 or 8 in shoes, I'd suggest choosing these socks in the 8-11 size just like I did. The past few months I've been having a lot of foot pain in the soles of my feet and I find that if my socks and shoes aren't cushioned enough then I can feel some pain every time I take a step. I have high arches and that may be the root cause of my foot pain, I'm not sure, but socks with a lot of cushioning seem to help. I could immediately tell just by touching these socks that they are made with thick, quality fabric. They definitely have extra cushioning on the bottom and so once I put them on, I realized how comfortable they are to walk in. I don't feel the shock of the hard ground underneath my foot with each step that I take when I am wearing these. They are made with breathable fabric on the top though so eventhough they are cushy, they still allow air to flow to your feet so that your feet don't sweat. If you are wearing them to exercise and your feet do happen to sweat though then that's ok because the fabric is moisture wicking so your feet still stay dry. The cuffs go about 3 inches past my ankles and that's perfect for me because I have fairly thick ankles and lower cut socks tend to leave elastic marks around my ankle so I really like that these socks go higher up onto my leg. They are tight enough that they stay up and don't sag or fall but not so tight that they leave marks on my skin. I'm a tough critic when it comes to socks and so I'm actually surprised at how much I like these since it's rare that I find a sock that I love. If you want a sock that's soft, comfy, breathable, moisture wicking, stays up and goes up higher than your lower ankle then these are a fantastic choice.

title: Buon materiale ma: scendono e non mantengono più di tanto il calore
content: DESCRIZIONE DELL’ARTICOLO I calzini realizzati da CLOSEMATE, arrivano all’interno di un'elegante confezione in cartone. Una volta aperta quest’ultima, è infatti presente una carta molto fine e trasparente con il logo del produttore ripetuto, che coprono i 6 paia di calzini posti all’interno della confezione. Ognuno di essi è confezionato singolarmente e bloccato da un nastrino in cartone. Il materiale delle calze è molto morbido e molto elasticizzato, ma proprio su questo fronte mi sarei aspettato di meglio visto che dopo un po’ dall’utilizzo le calze tendono a scendere. La criticità peggiore però, resta che non mantengono il calore, trasformando il tutto in piedi freddi e ovviamente, compromettendo il comfort. Un vero peccato poiché ispiravano parecchia fiducia inizialmente, ma con un uso costante ho iniziato a notare le prime problematiche. CONCLUSIONI In conclusione, non sono rimasto particolarmente soddisfatto da queste calze, per quanto le continui ad utilizzare, mi sarei senza dubbio aspettato una calza che restasse più calda e, tenuto conto dell’elasticità, anche più ferma mentre invece durante il giorno e durante movimenti ordinari, queste scendono. Vengono vendute ad un prezzo di circa 20 euro, che tenuto conto di tutto può anche starci, peccato però per le criticità evidenziate.

content: J'ai pris ces chaussettes à taille basse afin de pouvoir les porter avec mes baskets lorsque je suis en pantacourt ou en short. Donc plutôt pour un usage estival. On a l'impression que les chaussettes ont vécu plusieurs années. Sur la fiche produit il est effectivement indiqué qu'elles se lavent à la main, mais pour moi c'est rédhibitoire pour des chaussettes. Je les recommande donc uniquement pour les personnes qui sont prêtes à les laver à la main, personnellement je sais que je n'en aurai jamais le courage.

Mi piace anche il bordo elastico con la fascia a compressione, che tiene le calze ben ferme senza stringere troppo. Non mi sono mai ritrovata a doverle sistemare mentre corro, cosa che succedeva spesso con altri modelli. Il design antiscivolo è un altro plus che apprezzo molto. In più, nella confezione ci sono 6 paia, così ne ho sempre un paio pulito pronto all’uso. Perfette anche da usare tutti i giorni, non solo per lo sport. Insomma, per chi cerca comodità, durata e performance in un calzino da allenamento, queste calze sono un’ottima scelta!

product_name: CLOSEMATE Bamboo Viscose Thin Ankle Socks for Men Women Non Slip 6 Pairs | Low Cut Fit, Lightweight & Breathable, Soft & Skin-Friendly for Casual, Work, Commuting
author: Cliente Amazon
title: Confortevoli e caldi, ma per favore non chiamateli ecologici!
content: Non avevo mai provato alcun indumento realizzato in bamboo e devo ammettere che questi calzini mi hanno incuriosito. Ho scelto la misura 39-42, ma per la mia taglia (42) risultano piuttosto fascianti, quasi piccoli. La consistenza della maglia e il filato, al tatto e alla vista, hanno caratteristiche di compattezza e liscezza che ricordano un po' le calze a compressione graduata; ottime le finiture e l'unica cucitura presente, in corrispondenza delle unghie dei piedi, non procura alcun fastidio. Rispetto a quanto indicato nella descrizione trovo che queste calze siano poco adeguate ad un uso sportivo. Dopo qualche giorno di prova ho riscontrato quanto segue: • Tendono a scaldare troppo i piedi, qualunque sia la calzatura abbinata. Nonostante queste giornate torride, con altre calze in cotone non provo questa sensazione spiacevole. • Non facilitano la traspirazione, semplicemente si inumidiscono con il sudore senza allontanarlo dal piede. • Se indossati con scarpe da running, a differenza dei calzini in cotone appositamente concepiti per uso sportivo, questi calzini in viscosa di bamboo riducono l'aderenza del piede alla calzatura favorendo un eccessivo scivolamento del piede all'interno della stessa sia in senso longitudinale, sia sotto l'effetto delle spinte laterali. Considerando invece un uso normale, non sportivo, queste calze risultano confortevoli e adatte all'uso quotidiano anche se è preferibile evitare di usarle durante la stagione più calda. Sebbene il produttore dichiari che filato risponde allo STANDARD 100 di OEKO-TEX, è bene sapere che la produzione della viscosa di bamboo prevede diversi processi di lavorazione della cellulosa ricavata dalle fibre dell'omonima pianta. Vi è poco di ecologico nella scelta di maglie e tessuti realizzati in viscosa di bamboo e, comunque la si voglia porre, non può essere considerata una fibra naturale. Il suo processo di lavorazione prevede un largo impiego di sostanze chimiche e sintetiche i cui effetti devono essere controllati, limitati e infine neutralizzati per evitare che possano essere nocivi all'uomo. Il concetto di sostenibilità, dunque, è relativo principalmente al fatto che le colture di bamboo, da cui si ricava la materia prima, crescono più velocemente rispetto a quelle da cui si ricavano altri filati di origine vegetale per poi rinnovarsi altrettanto rapidamente.

title: Soft and stretchy, but felt small, be sure to check the sizing table
content: This bra is really interesting in that it's one piece of fabric. The fabric itself is very soft, supple and stretchy. That said, I am guilty of not looking at the included chart to select the size, as the size I ordered did not fit. I can typically purchase non-underwire bras like sports bras that are 3XL (which I did in this case) and easily fit into them, but this one doesn't meet typical sizing expectations. The 3XL in this bra is only a D cup. Be sure to consult the included sizing table, and beware that if you are DD there is no way you can squeeze into this thing (trust me, I tried). That said, I was a D at one time, and the cups felt quite small even for a D. When I took it out of the box the cups were almost non-existent. I think the expectation is that the material should stretch, maybe? If this bra did fit, I would wear it in a heartbeat. I love the fact there's nothing that can poke or jab you, and there's no annoying hems or stitches that can rub.

author: 68online
title: Surprise par la qualité malgré une première impression mitigée
content: Au déballage, j'étais sceptique : une odeur synthétique et un aspect brillant qui ne criait pas 'coton'. Pourtant, une fois lavées et aux pieds, le confort est là. L'intérieur est en bouclette (très moelleux) et non en coton peigné lisse, ce qui est bien mieux pour l'amorti. La maille est plus aérée sur le dessus du pied pour la respiration, alors que le talon et le rebord sont plus denses pour le confort. L'étiquette préconise 30°C (sûrement pour protéger l'élasthanne), mais je les ai passées à 40°C. Résultat : elles n'ont pas bougé, n'ont pas rétréci et surtout 0 bouloche à l'horizon. La hauteur est idéale, ni trop haute ni trop courte. Mention spéciale pour le rebord doublé à l'arrière du mollet, très confortable, ne cisaille pas la peau, ne laisse pas de marque disgracieuse. Chaussant du 38.5, j'ai opté pour le lot 39/42, je ne regrette pas mon choix pour l'instant. Par contre la compression au milieu du pied est légère de ce fait. Ce sont les deux roses qui me vont le mieux, elles sont moins larges que les vertes ( saute aux yeux quand on les pose l'une sur l'autre), les mauves sont entre les deux. C'est un phénomène classique lié aux différents bains de teinture qui font plus ou moins rétracter la fibre. J'utilise les vertes pour la maison (les plus larges), les roses pour le sport (meilleur maintien) et les mauves pour le quotidien. Ce lot est pas mal mais une chaussette de sport, c'est un outil technique, pas juste un morceau de tissu. Si elle glisse, si la couture blesse ou si le taillant est flou, c'est l'ampoule assurée au bout de 5 km de course. À 4,75 € la paire, c'est un bon dépanneur pour le quotidien, mais pas pour une pratique sportive exigeante.

author: Patrick
title: Avis d'un amateur de vtt et de courses à pied longues distances
content: Belles chaussettes au packaging superbe. A tort ou à raison, je ne suis jamais insensible à un conditionnement original et de qualité, car pour moi ça en dit long sur l'identité et les motivations d'une entreprise, mais encore faut-il que le produit soit à la hauteur… Ce sont de jolies chaussettes assez stylées. Le mélange de fond blanc et motifs gris clair est très réussi. Elles sont légèrement respirantes sur le dessus du pied, mais attention ce ne sont pas des chaussettes d'été. Assez épaisse, plutôt douce et relativement élastique elle "peut" en effet être assez confortable si la taille vous convient. Se restreindre à deux tailles comme le fait le fabricant (35/38 et 39/42), n'est peut-être pas judicieux, car les mécontents risquent d'être nombreux. (Je pense que 37/39, 40/42 et 43/45 est plus adapté aux besoins des clients). Pour exemple, ma femme, et sa pointure 38, se sent plutôt serrée dans ses chaussettes "35/38". Compétiteur vtt et courses à pied longues distances, je pense pouvoir vous dire qu'elles pourraient éventuellement convenir pour des petites sorties à vélo par temps frais, mais pas pour du running. Pour les autres sports, je ne sais pas…Rien de spécialement extraordinaire au niveau de la conception (Amortissement, antidérapant, compression, voute plantaire…), c'est pour moi des chaussettes assez standards. La finition n'est pas parfaite. Des coutures "dures et épaisses" aux niveaux des orteils et un resserrage trop prononcé au niveau des chevilles seront des points de gêne évident si vous êtes un sportif passionné. Ce sont des chaussettes "de tous les jours" et elle seront très bien pour se balader quotidiennement. Malgré quelques imperfections, elles sembles robustes et durables. Je craignais un léger rétrécissement après lavage, mais non, elles ont bien résisté (Machine 30°, essorage 800tr/mn et séchage à l'air libre mais pas en plein soleil…). A moins de 4€ la paire, le prix ne me semble pas déraisonnable, à condition de la taille vous convienne parfaitement. J'espère que mon commentaire vous sera utile

content: Sono un fanatico delle camminate ma questo mio hobby spesso mi causa problemi ai piedi…vesciche, talloniti. Il caldo estivo poi non aiuta. I piedi si gonfiano e i problemi aumentano. A volte con certe scarpe mi diventa fastidioso anche il contatto con l’asfalto. Questi calzini sono perfetti per chi cammina o fa jogging per la loro caratteristica di essere fatti di un tessuto traforato sopra il piede che permette la traspirazione e rinforzato, spugnoso e morbido sul tallone e la punta che ripara da urti e formazione di vesciche e di essere privi di cuciture sulla punta. In corrispondenza della pianta del piede il tessuto è sempre di spugna un po’ meno spessa. L’unico dubbio è che, al tatto, non sembra cotone 100% ma forse è dovuto al fatto che sono particolarmente elasticizzati e potrebbero contenere una percentuale di elastan. Comunque la sensazione addosso camminando e correndo risulta assolutamente positiva. Anche dopo il lavaggio i calzini hanno mantenuto forma ed elasticità originarie.

author: flowergrrl
title: Cold Water Wash
content: I was looking for socks to replace some that I inherited from my mother almost 10 years ago so I had expectations of durability that are probably not realistic in today’s world. That said, these socks are amazing. They are not as heavy as the 100% cotton socks I inherited, but that’s a plus in this unrelenting summer heat. However, they have some amazing cushioning in the soles which I was not expecting; they put a little spring in my step! And they are the perfect ankle length and don’t slide down. I was very excited with my order. I wear a size 8.5 women’s shoe but I ordered the size 8-11 socks because white cotton socks go in with the bleach clothing on hot water wash in our laundry; I expect some shrinkage from cotton with that treatment. When I received the socks, they were marked as size medium, not the 8-11 that I had ordered. The socks fit well but I did not feel there was enough extra room to launder them as I intended. There are no laundering instructions on the website listing so I was a bit dismayed to read the fine print on the socks’ wrapper: “Due to the particularity of this fabric, we suggest washing with cold water and air dry. tumble dry with high temp should be avoided”. That also was not what I was expecting! I have a pet peeve with manufacturers who do not preshrink their clothing and instead, include special laundry instructions to compensate for the practice. But I had allowed for shrinkage with my order so I thought I’d experiment. I washed a few socks in cold water and extra low dry along with my lingerie. Those turned out great! Then I tried a few socks in hot water (no bleach) and dried them on medium. Yes, they did shrink both in length and width (see photo of size difference between the two laundering methods). Those washed and dried with higher heat are now tight enough around the ankle to leave a mark in my skin after prolonged wear. These are attractive, well-made socks that should have fit me after laundering. If one is willing to launder them as lingerie, these socks are amazingly comfortable and a good buy for the price.

author: engineerwife
title: Right content blend, too thin for what I wanted
content: I have been having a difficult time finding socks that used to be an easy item to purchase for either my husband or myself. I have some socks that are over eleven years old that are still in excellent condition and the big plus is that they don't make my feet sweat. Lately, sock textilers are putting more man-made materials in them with polyester being the choice to produce socks. I do not like much polyester in my socks as it makes my feet sweat. I found these Closemate Womens Thin Crew Socks, made in China, that had the right blend for me: mostly cotton, some Nylon and little polyester. You can find the material/content on the back side of the sock label which is shown in percentages. I found the right blend in this sock, but when I received them I noticed how thin which is how they are described. They are thin and more for dress wear. I returned them. I have found my preferred blend in men's black Goldtoe Sport crew size 8-12, 71% cotton 14% Nylon 13% polyester 2% Spandex, made in Honduras. I bought the latter for my husband, but they run small and fit me just right, somewhat loose in toe (foot size 7 1/2), nice cushioning and don't make my feet sweat. My last purchase of preferred blend socks were Gildan 80% cotton 17% Nylon 3% Spandex in black crew made in Honduras, but this company no longer makes this content blend. About four months ago I purchase here CLOSEMATE Women's Calf Crew Socks Comfortable Soft Cotton and Lightweight Sz M (85% cotton, 12% polyester 3% Spandex) and I'm disappointed that they make my feet sweat.

title: Soft, comfy running socks, but fit could be snugger for my taste
content: For context, I've been using a pack of running socks that I LOVE - they're soft, padded, and offer excellent compression. Unfortunately, they're out of my budget at the moment, so I've been looking around for a cheaper alternative. Are these CLOSEMATE ankle socks that alternative? Well, they're good, but not quite as good as my perfect pair. Currently priced at £18.99 for six pairs, these are really good value, coming in at less than £3.20 a pair (that's half the price of my other socks). These are soft, with a lovely bit of padding in the heel. I wore them for an easy run today, and had no problems - no rubbing, no irritation. Like many other running socks, they have a padded ankle enclosure, which is particularly nice. I ordered the 5-9 and normally wear a 6-7.5 (the larger size in trainers). I'd say these are a decent fit, but run a little large on me. And although they claim arch compression, they're not as snug and supportive as I'd like. Overall, though, they're really decent - and the six pack, for me, is enough for a whole week of gym and running, with a pair left over for laundry day. I always say you can tell the quality of socks by what they look like turned inside out - and these are almost identical either side. There's a high bar for me, but these are my favourite backup pair!

content: I bought the 3-pack of CLOSEMATE slouch socks for CAD $25, looking for something cozy and stylish to wear with boots and sneakers.
