They naturally slouch without feeling bulky. • Stretchy & Comfortable Fit: Designed for US women’s shoe sizes 5–11, they stretched easily over my calves without cutting in. Great for layering over leggings or under jeans. • All-Season Versatility: Not too thick, not too thin. I wore them in early fall and they were warm enough without overheating indoors. ❌ Cons • No Reinforced Heel or Toe: These are more fashion socks than rugged everyday wear. I wouldn’t wear them for hiking or heavy-duty use. • Basic Color Options: My pack came with black, white, and nd grey. They’re versatile, but I wish CLOSEMATE offered more earthy or vibrant tones. • Slight Pilling After Wash: After two machine washes (cold water, air dry), I noticed minor pilling. Not a dealbreaker, but worth noting. 💰 Price Evaluation (CAD $25 for 3 Pairs) At just over $8 per pair, these fall into the mid-range category. For the comfort and style, I’d say they’re worth it—especially if you’re after that retro scrunch look. They’re not heavy-duty socks, but they’re perfect for casual wear and layering. If you’re looking for cozy, stylish socks to elevate your fall outfits or lounge in comfort, the CLOSEMATE slouch socks deliver.

content: ✓ Im Rahmen des Amazon Vine-Programms teste ich dieses Produkt unabhängig und objektiv. Hochwertige Sneaker-Socken mit sehr gutem Tragekomfort – ideal für Sport und Alltag Ich habe das 6er-Set in Schwarz erhalten und bin insgesamt zufrieden. Die Socken bestehen aus einem weichen, hautfreundlichen Baumwollmix, fühlen sich angenehm auf der Haut an und sind atmungsaktiv. Die Mesh-Einsätze am Fußgewölbe sorgen für eine gute Belüftung, während die Polsterung an Ferse, Zehen und Sohle Stöße effektiv dämpft – ideal für Sport, längere Läufe oder ganztägiges Stehen. Für sehr heiße Sommertage sind sie jedoch weniger geeignet, da das Material relativ dick ist. Verarbeitung und Passform Der Fußgewölbe-Support stabilisiert den Fuß ohne einzuengen, und das elastische Bündchen verhindert Verrutschen. Die Socken sitzen gut, allerdings könnten sie bei schmalen Füßen leicht locker sein, weshalb man eventuell eine halbe Nummer kleiner testen sollte. Verstärkte Zehen- und Fersenpartien versprechen Langlebigkeit. Praktische Highlights: Atmungsaktiv und feuchtigkeitstransportierend, ideal für Training oder Alltag. Formstabil nach dem Waschen. Vielseitig: Gym, Laufen, Reisen oder Büro – unauffällig in Sneakers. Praktisches 6er-Pack. Für den Preis von ca. 3,30 € pro Paar (Setpreis aktuell 19,99 €) ist das Set angemessen. Kleinere Kritikpunkte: Bei sehr schmalen Füßen könnte die Passform etwas locker wirken, und ein etwas stärker gepolsterter Bund wäre wünschenswert. Insgesamt überzeugen Qualität, hoher Tragekomfort und gute Alltagstauglichkeit – daher gebe ich 4 Sterne. ➤ Mein Anspruch ist es, transparente und ehrliche Produktbewertungen zu verfassen, die bei Kaufentscheidungen weiterhelfen. 🙏 Danke fürs Lesen und gute Einkäufe!

author: Mark Bittner
title: Perfect Weight and excellent stretch
content: These CLOSEMATE socks seem like the perfect sock weight and thickness for me. For any who are sasquatch-like in foot size as I am, these work very well! Depending upon the cut of the shoe, I wear a size 14 or 15. I was a bit concerned, as frequently I have found that many manufacturers seem to size their socks closer to the smaller size when a span is given for different sizes. For example, as in a size that is called 10-13, in my personal opinion, the sizing tends to lean far more into the size 10 than the 13. The good news is that these fit me very well. I would definitely not want to risk shrinkage, so I will be cautious about that. I tend to get hot very easily, spending much of the summer in sandals and a lightweight moisture control type shirt and shorts for gardening, mowing and around the house kinds of projects. For me, on the occasions of church or a funeral or something of the kind when I do have a need to dress up a bit, I love a good-looking lightweight sock that can still stay up when you put them on. These are precisely what I love. These socks feel soft and comfortable to the touch. They have sufficient spandex that enables them to have a very nice stretch, so the fit is excellent. They conform comfortably to the foot. As a practical person, I also love to have the cotton polyester blend along with the spandex as that facilitates ease of use and washability. It is also an excellent combination to prevent colors from fading, not to mention running as easily. I will wash them in cool or at the most tepid water and will plan to hang dry them only, avoiding any chance for shrinkage. The fabric is smooth and beautifully sewn. Seams seem straight and they are simply an excellent sock! Given what I have already experienced, I would most definitely give my full recommendation for these socks. Additionally, they arrive in a rather elegantly attractive box, which would be excellent for gift giving. Another thing to note is that the socks are tightly wrapped into a very neat little round circle. Very nice. I only wish I could do that as neatly after I have washed them. They look so nice like that and take up so little room! I definitely give these my vote. I am confident that you will love these socks! Highly recommended!

title: This one did not work for me.
content: I had high hopes for this Closemate seamless bra, but unfortunately, the fit just didn’t work for me. The quality of the bra itself is decent, but the sizing is completely off. I typically wear a 36D (with an underbust measurement of 36 inches), and based on the brand’s size chart, I ordered the 2X-Large. However, the fit was not what I needed. The underbust band is too large in diameter around my chest (even at the tightest hook setting), and as a result, it lacks the support I need. The band under the cups in the front rolls up constantly, which is really annoying. The slightly padded cups are too small, causing mild spillover at the top, which doesn’t look flattering under a t-shirt. Additionally, the edge of the cup closest to the armpit gaps open, creating an awkward fit. The shoulder straps are wide and comfortable while being easy to adjust. While the bra is comfortable enough to wear around the house, it’s not suitable for all-day wear or under tighter clothing due to the poor fit and look under clothing. It’s a bit disappointing because I was looking for something that would be both comfortable and supportive, but this bra just doesn’t deliver in those areas. If you’re considering buying this, I’d recommend being cautious with the size chart—it didn’t work for me, and I ended up with a bra that doesn’t fit properly. It seems the under bust measurement guide in their size chart is off. I never have luck with bras sized S-M-L-XL-XXL. I will go back to actual band and cup sized underwire bras. I am 5 ft 10 in tall, 195 lbs, size 16-18 clothes, and wear a 36D, for comparison.

content: ¿Puede serte útil mi reseña? Para esta reseña tomo en consideración el precio y mi experiencia con artículos similares. He pedido estos calcetines porque suelo tener siempre los pies muy fríos y son pocos los calcetines que sirven para dar calor y la experiencia con estos, aunque no ha sido increíble, pero están bien. Os cuento más. 👍Lo más: • Son gruesos y acolchados. 👎Lo menos: • No calientan, mantiene el calor del pie cuando se produce calor en el cuerpo o se ponen con el pie caliente. 🙋Resumen: He estado probando los Closemate calcetines térmicos durante un poco más de una semana, y en general, han sido bastante efectivos para “mantener el calor”, aunque con algunos detalles que podrían mejorarse. Como suelo tener los pies fríos todo el tiempo, especialmente en casa, tenía muchas expectativas con estos calcetines. Lo bueno es que cuando consigo que el pie entre en calor, los calcetines realmente lo mantienen, lo cual es un punto a su favor. Sin embargo, si el pie ya está frío al ponerlos, no parecen hacer maravillas para calentar rápidamente. Uno de los aspectos que me sorprendió, y no de forma positiva, es que, al retirarlos del pie, descubrí que el interior dejaba muchas pelusas negras. Esto me hace pensar que los calcetines están perdiendo material en su interior, lo cual no me gusta nada, ya que al lavarlos seguramente soltaran aún más pelusa. Esto es algo a tener en cuenta si se busca un producto que se mantenga impecable con el paso del tiempo. Además, tras solo 6 o 7 días de uso, noté que en la planta del pie ya aparecían bolitas de tela, lo que le resta durabilidad al producto. Aunque son calcetines gruesos y no tan económicos, estos detalles hacen que no los considere como una opción ideal si se busca algo que resista bien el uso constante. A pesar de esto, cumplen con la función básica de mantener el calor una vez que el pie está lo suficientemente caliente, pero hay varios aspectos que podrían mejorarse para hacerlo un producto de mayor calidad. 📌 Evaluación general (3) ⭐⭐⭐ 🔍 Calidad de los materiales ⭐⭐⭐ 🔍 Presentación ⭐⭐⭐ 🔍 Funcionalidad ⭐⭐⭐ 🔍 Relación calidad-precio ⭐⭐⭐ 🙋Calidad de los materiales: Tienen una calidad promedio y mejorable. 🙋Presentación. content: ✷ Pack de 6 pares de calcetines grises para hombre o mujer, sin costuras, con puntos de refuerzo y muy cómodos de llevar, especialmente en verano. ☼ Vienen en una simple bolsa zip azul y 2 grupos de 5 pares. El tacto que tienen es suave y se ven realmente bien hechos. Si te dijeran que son de un fabricante conocido, colaría… y conozco bien esa marca. 🔘 Estos calcetines, aunque su diseño te dice que son de verano, tiene algo un poco desconcertante y es que, llevan un componente clave que los hace más calurosos que los de verano. Y es que estos tienen un 17% de Poliéster, mientras que los que son destinados a ser más frescos, suelen llevar Poliamida en su lugar. Tienen densa trama, muy buena sujeción, y no notas que aprietan demasiado. Son muy cómodos de llevar y la talla se ajusta bien a mi pie (calzo un 43). Después de haber usado 3 pares en 3 días, no se me han bajado ni enroscado en la base de la zapatilla deportiva. ☼ Como se puede ver en las fotos, en la parte superior del talón, hay una pequeña protuberancia para puedas tirar de ella y dejarlo rápido en su posición correcta. A su vez tiene todo el perímetro del tobillo reforzado, así como la zona del talón y el arco del pie. 🔘 A mí no me sudan los pies en exceso, así que no he podido ver si realmente es efectivo el hecho que la humedad se vaya toda al exterior a través de la zona del empeine. Lo único que puedo corroborar es lo comentado antes, no dan nada de calor ni son nada angostos. ☼ De cara al lavado, al ser básicamente algodón con algo de mezcla sintética, se pueden lavar en lavadora a 30ºC sin temor a que te puedan encoger. No se recomienda secar en secadora, pero también te diré por experiencia de muchos años, que un programa de secado de aire frío, no les hace absolutamente nada. 📌 El precio de este pack de calcetines (sobre los 27€), me parece al exagerado siendo que hay cosas idénticas por hasta 10€ menos y con 4 pares más. ✪ CONCLUSIÓN: ⭐ Me han gustado, y los veo como una muy buena opción aceptable como calcetines de primavera-verano, pero su precio está algo fuera de mercado en estos momentos. No obstante, por calidad, son recomendables. 💬 Espero que esta revisión y lo comentado, te haya sido de utilidad. 👀

author: BW
title: Worst Socks I've Ever Bought
content: At first these sock looked great. They came in a pretty box, neatly packed and were soft cotton, they said. Without a doubt, these are the worst socks I've ever bought. It turns out they are 80% cotton, 15% Polyester, not only a plastic against your skin [bad for your health] but one of the hottest substances known to man. But I would recommend them if you are planning on growing mushrooms in your shoes - except for one thing, the fit. I've bought socks before so I know how this works. Manufacturers are afraid of giving you the slightest amount of extra fabric, that's why many of them make One Size Fits No One products. Having a size 12 foot I wisely ordered the XL 12-15 size, figuring more is better and they will shrink but they outsmarted me and sent what I would sell as an 8-10 size. So the socks fit snugly and felt strange going on, which made me look further. To give you some context I have skinny feet [left to right & top to bottom], medium sized ankle and it's thin going up to medium sized calf up high. I pull the socks up as they are supposed to rest on the calf but no-go,they are the length of crew socks. They feel funny, are tight and stretch weirdly so I take them off and stretch the leg inside with both hands. OMG, am I surprised to find an elastic square lattice work with large holes; I can see thru it totally. Every once in a while at the intersection of the horizontal and vertical spandex, I find a tiny tuft of fabric. This sounds really weird, I know, but when you release the stretch, it looks like a normal fabric. So they figured out how to make a sock with hardly any fabric in it. All I wanted was a normal sock, where they twist fibers to make threads then weave them perpendicular to each other and if you stretch it you have a piece of cloth. This was totally unacceptable and I returned them. I can't remember if they were from Bangladesh but they were sized for 125 pound men, which doesn't work here. Do yourself a favor and keep looking; it's hard to find Real 100% cotton socks, I know.

Die Stäbchen in den Seiten sind gut verarbeitet und drücken nicht. Er ist sehr weich und passt sich gut der Körperform an. DIe Cups kann man heraus nehmen, tragen für mich persönlich aber zuviel auf und dadurch passt der Sitz der Körbchen nicht zu 100%. Ich habe mich für die Farbe schwarz entschieden. Die Größe anhand der Größentabelle war gut passend. Bei einer normalen BH Größe von 90C habe ich 3XL genommen. Ansonsten ein schöner, angenehmer BH ohne Bügel der weich ist und zu vielen verschiedenen Aktivitäten getragen werden kann.

Fazit: Insgesamt sind die Closemate Bambus Sneaker Socken eine gute Wahl für komfortable und atmungsaktive Socken. Die Farbabweichung schmälert jedoch den Gesamteindruck etwas. Daher gebe ich 4 von 5 Sternen. Bewertung: 4 von 5 Sternen

author: WN
title: The packaging will knock your socks off!
content: You'd think by the packaging that you were getting socks made out of gold. It definitely has a professional and "wow" factor the moment you open it up. I've never bought socks packaged so well. The socks themselves are true-to-fit. I wear a 9.5-10 size shoe and the medium fits well without being too snug. They are definitely a dress-cock type of feeling with 80% cotton and the rest of synthetic fibre. I have worn these during sub-zero Canadian mornings while walking my child to the bus stop and can report that they are neither warm nor cool your feet down. In other words, they are as warm as your typical dress sock - don't expect thermal performance like a wool or hiking sock. The elastics are not constricting like a crew sport sock. They do sag over time but that is not unlike any other dress sock I've worn. You will also be relieved to know that they do not cause undue sweating or smells, so you are safe if you need to remove shoes at the airport security checkpoint. Overall, the socks are soft and presented well. If you consider socks a disposable, utilitarian item, then the price point may not be for you. You can likely find cheaper alternatives elsewhere. Otherwise, the marketing will make your mind feel as good as your feet. Recommended.

author: Jay Ray
title: My new favorites, maybe for decades to come
content: I need to be cautious on how I give advice concerning this product, in a couple of areas, as I rebegan my hiking this year, I previously last did thirtyish years ago, and traditionally I've been very allergic to wool. There's an additional factor, that I've been a one model of socks wearer for about twenty years, although I tested a few odd pairs every few years. I should add that recently I did wear another type of sock over my old ones for sleeping. Anyways, these hiking socks are absolutely super! The wool actually seems to be helping with the dry itch I start getting in the fall, and that makes sense since Merino has some water resistant properties, which are probably keeping a bit more moisture next to my ankles. I'd only tried one other wool sock product in my adult life, at a percentage of Merino more than double these socks contain, and I felt a reaction, so they got returned. I'm still going to try products with increasing percentages, because of my long-trail aspirations, but these socks may have found the right mixture for skin health, for me to avoid any hint of allergy or hives. There's another area where these socks shine, at least as compared to my out of date information. The seams feel absolutely smooth, at both the toe and the ankle cuff. They are visible, but they have no extra bulk to them, so the impression is that the entire sock is a molded perfect fit. My socks of twenty years were at about the same price level as these, and also about the same in softness, but these are much more suited seasonally for the winter. About four months ago, I ordered an expensive, non-wool hiking sock that is highly recommended here at Amazon, at 4.6 after about one thousand reviews, and I hated them. They were overly cushioned for me, and at first glance, I worried these would be the same, but they aren't. They feel just-right for the rock scramble type hiking I'll run into most in my area. Will I wear them with toe socks like all the thru-hikers are recommending? Never! Will I wear them all winter? Absolutely! Do I plan to buy these again? Almost guaranteed, especially since my former favorites aren't available anymore.

author: Mrs M
title: Supremely Comfortable But Cups On The Small Size. A Good Post Surgery Bra
content: These bras arrive in lovely packaging, making them very giftable. They are very comfortable bras to wear. Indeed, I can hardly feel I am wearing one. The fabric is extremely thin, extremely soft and smooth. There are no uncomfortable wires to dig in and no label to scratch. They are full cover bras which means it comes right up under the arm and right over the breasts. There is a small bone sewn in to the sides but well away from the breast, just to stop the very soft fabric bunching up, I imagine. It cannot be felt when wearing the bras. I like the colours too. I have a coffee coloured one and a very pretty pink one. The main difficulty is the sizing. I think there is always a difficulty when buying a bra that is supposed to fit more than one size. There is a reason different bra sizes were invented originally! This bra is no exception. I ordered a Medium, which should fit anything from a 34B or C to a 36A excluding a D cup. I am a 34B but have one larger breast due to breast cancer and the smaller breast is probably smaller than a b cup these days. The cups on this Medium bra fit the smaller breast perfectly but are too small for the slightly larger breast. This leads me to suggest that ladies with a small 34B or a 34A will be fine, but anything above that would be better off ordering a size up. These bras also have too much to spare under the arms and the fabric bags a bit even on the tightest hook row. That applies to the side with the larger breast which bulges over the top of the bra. There is still too much fabric under the arm. I could go to a Large size and wear a fillet in the small side but then I thing the whole bra would be too loose as the Medium has to be done up on the tightest setting or it feels too loose around my back. I would still recommend this bra for after breast cancer surgery as it is supportive, soft and seamless with nothing to rub against surgery scars but go up a cup size when looking at the chart.

title: Molto comode e fatte benissimo
content: Ho voluto provare le calze antiscivolo Closemate principalmente per l’attività sportiva, e devo dire che sono rimasto davvero colpito dalla qualità complessiva. Appena tolte dalla confezione, si percepisce subito l’attenzione ai dettagli e la qualità dei materiali. Il tessuto, un mix di cotone pettinato, nylon, poliestere e spandex, risulta incredibilmente morbido al tatto, elastico e confortevole. Una volta indossate, le calze si adattano perfettamente al piede, avvolgendolo in maniera sicura senza essere troppo strette. Ciò che mi ha stupito maggiormente sono stati i pad antiscivolo in silicone: a differenza di altri modelli che ho provato, questi non si sentono sotto al piede quando cammino senza scarpe, questo sottili e fatti con un materiali diverso, li ritengo più comodi ma peccano dal punto di vista dell’aderenza, specie dopo qualche ora che si cammina in casa senza scarpe/ciabatte. In generale, queste calze sono state pensate per chi cerca sia comfort che prestazioni durante l’attività sportiva, e sono state create con con differenti spessori nei vari punti del piede, in questo modo abbiamo maggiore resistenza dove serve e leggerezza nella parte superiore. Nel complesso, sono davvero soddisfatto, sono calze ben fatte, comode e pratiche, con un rapporto qualità-prezzo eccellente. L’unica ragione per cui non do cinque stelle è che i pad antiscivolo che non mi hanno completamente convinto, ma non è un difetto che mi fa ricredere sulla qualità del prodotto. 4 stelle.

content: I definitely recommend these socks for both men and women! I have been looking for no-show socks for awhile that do not slide down or dig into the back of my heels. Since they do come up a little higher on the top of the foot, they are perfect for shoes like keds, sperrys, etc. My other no show socks would not come up high enough on those shoes, leaving the shoe to uncomfortably rub the top of my foot, causing pain and irritation. In the photo, you can see that I did also try these socks in my low cut business flats and they were too high to look right. However, those shoes cut right above my toes, so it was a long shot. The socks are soft, and I like that you can choose from different colors. I am a woman and generally wear between a size 7-8.5 depending on the style. These socks fit comfortably on me and do not look too big or loose, though I can tell that they could still stretch quite a bit more for a larger foot. I would definitely recommend these socks if you are looking for something comfortable and low profile.

author: J
content: If you’re in the market for a pair of warm and cozy socks, these Merino Wool Socks might be on your radar, especially if you're a fan of the natural softness and temperature-regulating properties of merino wool. While these socks certainly provide comfort, they come with a mix of materials that might leave some purists wanting more. Material Breakdown: These socks are made from 30% Merino Wool, with the remainder consisting of 35% Acrylic, 22% Nylon, 10% Polyester, and 3% Spandex. 30% Merino Wool: The star of the show. Merino wool is known for being soft, breathable, and insulating, making it perfect for keeping your feet warm in winter and cool in summer. However, with only 30% merino wool, you're not getting the full benefits of this high-performance fiber. For some, this may be a drawback, especially if you're used to 100% merino wool socks. 35% Acrylic: Acrylic is often used as a cost-effective alternative to wool. It adds durability and helps keep the socks soft, but it lacks the moisture-wicking properties and natural odor resistance that merino wool offers. 22% Nylon: Nylon adds strength and helps with the sock’s elasticity, ensuring they hold their shape well over time. 10% Polyester: This synthetic material adds durability, moisture resistance, and quick-drying properties. However, it also means the socks are less breathable than they would be with more natural fibers. 3% Spandex: A small amount of spandex helps with stretch and provides a snug fit, making the socks comfortable without feeling too tight. Comfort and Warmth: Despite the low percentage of merino wool, these socks are still relatively warm and soft on the feet. Merino wool naturally regulates body temperature, and even at 30%, you can still feel its insulating properties, which help keep your feet warm in cooler weather. The mix of acrylic and polyester also contributes to the overall softness and comfort, making them a cozy option for everyday wear. Durability and Fit: The inclusion of nylon and spandex ensures these socks will hold up well over time. They retain their shape, don’t stretch out excessively, and have a nice fit that conforms to the contours of your feet. The socks also provide decent elasticity, meaning they stay snug around the ankles without being overly tight. Moisture-Wicking and Odor Control: One area where these socks fall a bit short compared to 100% merino wool socks is moisture-wicking and odor resistance. Merino wool excels at both, but with only 30% wool content, these socks don't quite match up. While they do a decent job of managing sweat and keeping your feet dry, they’re not as efficient as full-merino socks. Likewise, they won’t resist odors as effectively over long periods of wear, especially if you're using them for high-performance activities like hiking or running. Value for Money: Given the lower merino wool content, the price of these socks is typically more affordable compared to pure merino wool options. They strike a decent balance between price and performance, making them an attractive choice for those who want the warmth and comfort of wool without the premium price tag. However, if you’re specifically seeking the benefits of merino wool, you might find yourself wishing for a higher percentage. Final Thoughts: These Merino Wool Socks are a solid choice if you’re looking for warmth, comfort, and a bit of the luxurious feel of merino wool, but without the high price of 100% wool socks. The blend of synthetic materials helps with durability and fit, but it does compromise some of the moisture-wicking and odor-resisting benefits of wool. If you're not overly concerned with having a high percentage of merino wool and simply want a warm, cozy sock for general wear, these socks will do the job just fine. For those who prioritize full merino wool benefits, though, you may want to look for a product with a higher wool content.

title: Super comfy, super stretch
content: While some size 12-15 socks end up so long that the heel rides up the back of the foot, the Closemate fit perfectly. Their length is only 8 inches, heel to toe, but will stretch out to 15 inches. The overall fit is snug, not quite as tight as a compression sock. The top of the sock measures 12 inches to the floor when wearing. The mostly cotton fabric is very comfortable and provides a feeling of cushion on the bottom despite having the thickness of an average dress sock. At the price point they represent a good value and are as nice as a premium sock I spent too much money on in the past. My only problem, and the reason for 4 instead of 5 stars, is they are a little too snug around the heel/front of ankle circumference. As seen in one photo, that cross section when stretched is about 8 inches. While that's enough to go around, it's still a bit tight and less accomodating than I'd prefer. But every sock I've tried, and I've tried and measured dozens, is the same. It's apparently a manufacturing standard on their weaving machines. As seen in another photo, the wrinkles at that 'top of the foot, bottom of the leg' is also an industry standard which is why advertising photos always show the toe pointed - they have to stretch out those naturally occuring wrinkles. The foot spends most of its time at 90 degrees to the leg. Why can't socks be made to yield to that anatomical fact? The wrinkles leave their imprint on the skin for an hour after the sock is removed as well. Again, I'm not picking on Closemate since it's an industry standard. The Closemate is actually better than most due to the abundant stretch in all directions. No, I'm not diabetic and have very healthy feet. And in reality the diabetic socks I've tried were no better. With the high cotton content I hope there will be zero to minimal shrinkage in the wash. I'll update if that happens. I have some similar cotton blend socks that have not shrunk, so I suspect these will pass that test.

content: Se trata de un set de 6 pares de calcetines deportivos tobilleros de la marca Closemate, concretamente el modelo "2Rojo2Verde2Naranja" en tres colores diferentes. Los calcetines presentan una correcta calidad de fabricación, aunque la parte interior presenta muchos hilos sueltos. La confección en general está bastante bien, no tienen costuras excesivamente grandes y los calcetines se adaptan bien al pie. La verdad es que son muy similares a otros calcetines de running que tengo y que me costaron algo más. Están confeccionados con un 85% de algodón, un 12% de poliéster y un 3% de elastano, por lo que resultan bastante elásticos; algo necesario cuando son válidos desde el número 43 al número 46. El tejido es suave y agradable al tacto y la verdad es que dado que tengo un pie grande, el ajuste resulta adecuado. En cuanto a las pegas, sólo he encontrado una y es que en la parte delantera, la que quedaría sobre los dedos de los pies, tiene una costura que, sin ser muy grande, tras hacer ejercicio o andar un rato con ellos, termina resultando molesta (al menos para mi). Este problema lo estoy encontrado en bastantes calcetines, por lo que entiendo que el hecho de que esa costura esté justamente ahí, obedece más a una necesidad que a un capricho, pero en cualquier caso, en la medida de lo posible, intento encontrar calcetines sin costuras, aunque no es tarea fácil, jajaja. Y, en cuanto al precio, lo encuentro algo elevado, máxime cuando hay calcetines muy similares en cuanto a diseño y características, que cuestan menos de la mitad. Debido al elevado precio y la costura molesta, mencionada anteriormente, no puedo otorgarles una valoración mejor... Espero que esta opinión te haya sido útil :)

title: solo il 30% di merino, il resto sintetico. Prodotto povero a prezzo esagerato. voto 5.2
content: Sono un po’ distratto in questo periodo. Felice di aver ordinato dei calzini merino, per lo sport e per stare in casa, appena aperti, ho visto che, in realtà, la composizione è piuttosto povera: 30% merino, 35% acrilico non specificato, 22% nylon, e 3% spandex. C’è anche ben scritto sull’inserzione, ma non avevo colto. Non trovo plausibile per queste quantità di lana e tessuto sintetico un prezzo di 27 euri. Sono calzini in cui la merino non è molta, serve solo per aumentare il prezzo. Penso anche che sia il prezzo di listino iniziale, poi deve calare almeno del 60%. Sono calzini paragonabili ai Cat da lavoro, o altri da lavoro, generici, che puoi trovare all’Eurobrico per un terzo del prezzo. Tra l’altro ho anche da poco provato dei calzini merino di altra marca ignota cinese, “CAOZITOU 3 paia di calzini”, che a 13 euri danno tre paia di calzini con il 60% di lana merino (25% poliestere, 12% nylon, 3% elastan). Quindi si tratta di calzini con basso tenore di lana merino, alta percentuale di fibre sintetiche (70%), che possono dare un certo discomfort al freddo, con l’effetto bagnato/freddo, che hanno un prezzo fuori mercato per quello che offrono. Così come sono, per il rapporto qualità/prezzo, non posso che dare 3 stelle e un voto sotto la sufficienza. C’è di meglio ad un prezzo decisamente inferiore, qui su Amazon. Hanno presentazione altisonante, come calzini in merino da trekking, ma sono poco più di calzini generici da lavoro.

content: I believe that the cushion that these socks provide is exactly the correct amount; it is not too thick, but it is sufficient to provide my feet with some additional comfort while I am engaging in activities that involve high-impact. What differentiates these socks from other sports socks that I have tested is the anti-slip grip that they use. In the past, I've had problems in which my foot would slide inside my soccer shoes while I was making rapid stops or quick cutbacks. This could be quite aggravating, and it may even occasionally lead to minor injuries. On the field, my performance and confidence have both significantly increased as a result of the fact that I am wearing these grip socks, which make me feel much more comfortable and ensure that my feet remain in position. Not only are the grips on the soles strategically positioned, but they also provide outstanding traction without being very unpleasant. I believe that this concept is particularly effective for sports like basketball and soccer, which need players to make snap decisions about their direction of play. I was pleasantly surprised by how well these socks performed on my yoga mat when I wore them during a handful of yoga sessions that I did at home instead of going to a studio. I had not anticipated that they would perform as well for yoga as they do for field sports; nonetheless, they provided me with the ideal amount of grip to maintain postures without sliding.

title: Calcetines tobilleros de bambú (talla escasa pero cómodos).
content: Nunca he sido muy amigo de los calcetines tobilleros (yo soy más clásico), pero ante la insistencia de mi pareja me decidí a probar con estos. No sé cómo de ecológicos serán (tienen un 10% de plásticos), pero resultan cómodos. Se hace rato eso de tener el tobillo más al aire, pero se acostumbra uno. La talla es MUY justa. Tenlo en cuenta. Se supone que estos calcetines son de tallas 43-46 y yo calzo entre el 42 y el 43 y me vienen justos. Después de ponerse las zapatillas y empezar a andar ya no se notan, pero la primera impresión es que van algo justos, así que no me quiero imaginar el que realmente calce un 46. Todavía no los he probado tras un lavado, así que no podría decir si encogen. No he notado sudoración (tras una hora y 7 km de paso rápido), así que parece que cumplen su cometido. ¡Veremos con el tiempo su durabilidad! EDITO: Después de unos cuantos usos empecé a notar "algo raro". Alguna molestia entre los dedos y alguna gota de sangre al quitarme el calcetín (lo achacaba al ejercicio o a algún problema en la uña). ¡Parece que soy alérgico al bambú! Empieza como un leve picor y poco a poco se acaban produciendo lesiones en la piel. Hoy ha sido ponérmelos y a los 5 minutos empezar las molestias. Una lástima, pero tengo que dejar de usarlos. No quito ninguna estrella porque supongo que la mayoría de gente no serán alérgicos. EDITO2: Le he pasado a mi mujer estos calcetines ya que yo no puedo usarlos. Ella calza un 39, y también le resultan pequeños.

author: Thomas Fournier
title: Way Better Than Expected – Comfy, Stay Put, and Look Good Doing It!
content: Okay, real talk—when I pulled these socks out of the pack, I laughed out loud. They looked tiny. I’ve got size 9 feet, and I seriously thought there was no way I’d squeeze into them. But I gave it a shot, and to my surprise, they stretched perfectly and snugged right on. Not just that—they stay put. I’ve had so many no-show socks in the past that looked promising but would end up sliding off halfway through the day or bunching up inside my shoe. These don’t budge. The little silicone strips on the heel are super discreet but really do the trick. Once they're on, they stay where they’re supposed to, and you forget they’re even there—which is the whole point of a good no-show sock, right? Fit and comfort-wise, they’ve got a lot going for them. The material feels soft but not flimsy—like they’re built to actually last a while, not dissolve in the wash after a few wears. There’s some breathable mesh over the top which is subtle but helps keep things cooler and a little less swampy on warmer days. I’ve worn these for everything from casual walking around to longer active days, and they held up well—no heel slippage, no sagging, and no annoying rubbing. They’re not the thinnest socks, but I wouldn’t call them thick either—they’re a nice balance, especially if you’re pairing them with sneakers or slip-ons. I wouldn’t wear these with boat shoes or ultra-low loafers, though—they do peek out a tiny bit in those cases. The color combos are actually pretty slick. There’s a bit of style going on without being loud, so they’re not just boring black or white basics. Even if you’re not showing them off, it’s a nice touch. They’re versatile enough for gym shoes, daily sneakers, or even just lounging around the house if you're like me and prefer a no-show feel even indoors.

title: They are cream coloured (not white) and the fit runs on the small side
content: These socks are low cut ankle socks, good staples to have in your sock drawer. They are listed as white, but the colour is actually cream or light beige. They are not white-white. I take women's US size 6.5 in shoes, and these socks were a little small on my feet. It felt like there was pressure on the tips of my toes, from the fabric pulling against them, due to the small size. The socks did not slide down my heels. The price ($20 for 6 pairs) is not terrible, but I think you could find similar quality for a lower price at a store that rhymes with Hall-Mart. In case you're thinking that bamboo is an eco friendly fabric and is worth a price premium, like I did, here's a not-fun-fact that I just learned: It turns out that bamboo is NOT eco friendly. It is a fibrous wood, and many chemicals are used to break down the wood fibres to make them soft enough to spin into a yarn, so that the yarn can be made into fabric. The chemical sludge that bamboo is soaked in is not good for the environment. And bamboo fabric is only part bamboo--the rest is polyester (hence the viscose in these socks).

author: Daedalus
title: Angenehmer BH mit eingeschränkter Funktionalität
content: Vorab: Ich bin Amazon Vine Produkt Tester und erhalte die Produkte kostenlos von Amazon. Ich versuche dennoch eine objektive Bewertung dazu abzugeben und Produkte zu testen, die mir und meiner Familie mit Kindern einen gewissen Mehrwert bringen. Ich nutze dabei das gesamte Bewertungsspektrum aus und gebe sowohl gute Bewertungen als auch schlechte Wertungen ab - egal ob ich das Produkt gratis erhalten habe. Nun zum eigentlichen Produkttest: Der bügellose Soft-BH macht auf den ersten Blick einen guten Eindruck, vor allem durch die aufwändige Verpackung. Er kommt in einer Pappschachtel mit Magnetverschluss und zusätzlicher Folie – eine sehr edle Präsentation für einen Alltags-BH. Allerdings finde ich die Verpackung etwas übertrieben und nicht wirklich notwendig, besonders wenn man bedenkt, dass es sich um ein Kleidungsstück für den täglichen Gebrauch handelt. Zum Produkt selbst: Meine Frau hat den BH in Größe XL getestet, obwohl sie normalerweise Größe L trägt. Die XL passt zwar, fällt jedoch recht knapp aus. Besonders das Körbchen bietet zu wenig Platz, was den Tragekomfort etwas einschränkt. Frauen mit größerer Oberweite sollten auf jeden Fall eine größere Größe in Betracht ziehen. Das Tragegefühl ist insgesamt angenehm, und der Stoff fühlt sich weich und bequem auf der Haut an. Für sportliche Aktivitäten oder körperlich anspruchsvolle Tätigkeiten ist der BH jedoch nicht geeignet. Er bietet viel zu wenig Halt, sodass alles schnell in Bewegung gerät – "Wackelpudding" beschreibt es wohl am besten. Für einen gemütlichen Nachmittag auf dem Sofa oder einen entspannten Tag zu Hause mag er ausreichend sein, aber als Allround-BH ist er nur bedingt empfehlenswert. Fazit: Dieser Soft-BH punktet mit einer hochwertigen Verarbeitung und angenehmem Tragegefühl, bietet jedoch zu wenig Halt für mehr als ruhige Gelegenheiten. Die aufwändige Verpackung ist ein schönes Detail, aber für ein Alltagsprodukt aus meiner Sicht überflüssig. Wer einen BH für leichte Belastungen oder Entspannung sucht, könnte hier fündig werden. Für Sport oder einen aktiveren Alltag würde ich jedoch nach einem stabileren Modell suchen.

title: 温かかいけど普通
content: 例えば就寝中、足が暑くなるような人向けなのかなと思います。私は足が冷える人なので、こちらの売りである「厚手パイル生地」には首をかしげてしまいます。冬季はもっと厚手の物を履くので。 普段は27から28cmの靴を履いています。こちらのLサイズは28cm以上とあったので、重ね履きを想定し大き目のLサイズを発注しました。 履いた印象としては、特に大きく感じません。つま先からかかとまでがジャストサイズです。また、今はまだ下したてゆえか、ふくらはぎ部分がタイトに感じます。じきトータルでジャストフィットに落ち着くと思うので、大柄な人はLサイズをお勧めします。 こちらの素材構成を見ると、なんと4種も使われています。恐らく、防寒・保温・吸湿・放湿それぞれに適合させるためなのかなと。これが正解なら、冒頭で触れた足が暑くなる人は、この靴下のみで十分かと思います。 洗濯情報です。 見慣れないマークがあって良く分かりませんが、塩素系・酸素系漂白とタンブラー乾燥が不可なのは分かりました。こちらが想定している使用方法であれば、洗濯は手洗いのみなどあり得ませんので、通常洗濯で大丈夫でしょう。 私に言わせれば、特に何だということのない普通の厚みな靴下です。ただし、情報が正しければウールとアクリルの使用で全体の65％ですから、確かに温かさを感じました。秋や春にはちょうど良いかなと思います。 なお、一度洗わずいきなり履いたせいか、もう滑っちゃって大変です。お気を付けください。

There's a lot to like about them, they're good and stretchy, as well as soft and warm. They feel mostly like regular socks, just thicker and warmer, rather than feeling completely different as the standard "wooly socks" do. There's not a lot to critique here, they're socks, they're warm, great for winter, stretchy and comfortable. They also feel durable, I'm not worried about them falling apart. The only potential complaint is the price, because $36 for 3 pairs of socks is about double the competition's price here on Amazon, but I did have a look since I was curious, and found that these socks, with their 30% Merino wool, has a higher wool content than the others I looked at in every case. The second highest percentage I saw was 25%, so these is more wool in these. If that is something that appeals to you, well it may be worth it. I don't know for sure whether I'd pay double what I'd pay for a similar set of 3 pairs of socks, but I do know that these are very nice socks and I'm glad I have them.

author: Usually happy
title: Mislabeled, these are definitely not winter socks
content: The material used in these socks is nice, thinner than expected with socks that are aimed at being used in the winter, but nice. The sizing, according to the seller's details was correct - with an item that needs detailing, see ** below. ✓ Unlike a lot that are sold as "crew socks," these are actually long enough to sit up high on the shins where they should. There is a lot of stretch, which makes them comfortable to wear all day. The toe and heel areas are nicely re-enforced. ** They slip on easily, but the top doesn't have enough elasticity to keep them from being stretched to the point that the material tries to contract, and the sock then slides down because of the narrower area above the ankle. The top needs to be more relaxed so that it stays in position. It's a bugger always needing to pull socks up, and with these, unless a person has toothpick legs, they will slide down. I mentioned that they are thin for winter socks. When I see "winter" in relation to socks I expect a thicker product that has an actual thermal insulation factor. These do not have any insulation factor. When pulling the socks up and there is some stretch, I can see daylight through them. Real winter socks are thicker, much thicker and do not allow light to pass through. On the upside, I haven't had any negative reactions to the wool. I generally can wear wool socks for a couple of hours before the itching starts, but with these, I've been able to go for a full eight hours with no itching. In the end, these will make ok summer socks as the thin material allows heat to flow through the material. So overall, they are pricing for "winter" socks since they have almost no insulation value.

author: mh
title: Comfortable but overengineered
content: These socks are… odd. There's nothing particularly wrong with them and they're decent socks. They're soft and have a true-to-size fit. They have a nicely quilted pad under the forefoot. They're low profile, if that's what you're looking for. But there are also some aspects that seem less than ideal or just plain odd. While the fabric on the bottom is fairly thick, it's very thin on top, which probably lends to breathability but just feels off. For some reason there's quilting in front of the heel, not under the heel itself. Maybe it pads the plantar fascia? Visually, I don't find the top very appealing around the ankle where the heel-side is very thick and the front is very thin. If you're wearing these as daily socks instead of just for sports then the look might make a difference to you; my preference is for a nice, uniform cuff to the top of the sock. There's also a block of stripes around the back of the sock which look like they might be a hi-viz design - they're yellow on the black socks and gray on the white socks -- but they don't appear to be reflective. And since most of the pattern gets covered by the shoe, I'm not sure why it exists.

author: Marco Ram
title: Wertige Socken
content: Ich habe mir die CLOSEMATE 6 Paar Sneaker Socken Herren in der Größe 43–46 bestellt, weil ich für Sport und Alltag bequeme, kurze Socken gesucht habe. Nach einigen Wochen Nutzung beim Training, Joggen und auch im täglichen Gebrauch kann ich sagen, dass ich insgesamt sehr zufrieden mit dem Set bin. Besonders positiv fällt der Tragekomfort auf. Die Socken bestehen aus gekämmter Baumwolle mit einem kleinen Anteil Nylon und Elasthan, wodurch sie angenehm weich sind und sich gut an den Fuß anpassen. Sie sitzen bequem, ohne zu drücken, und bleiben auch während der Bewegung zuverlässig an ihrem Platz. Gerade beim Joggen oder im Fitnessstudio ist das ein großer Vorteil. Sehr gut gefällt mir auch die Fußgewölbeunterstützung. Man merkt tatsächlich, dass die Socken etwas mehr Halt bieten als einfache Standardsocken. Dadurch fühlen sich die Füße auch bei längeren Trainingseinheiten stabil an und ermüden nicht so schnell. Zusätzlich sorgt die Frotteeverstärkung im Bereich der Ferse und des Vorfußes für eine angenehme Polsterung. Das dämpft Schritte etwas ab und macht das Laufen oder Training deutlich komfortabler. Ein weiterer Pluspunkt ist die Atmungsaktivität. Durch den Mesh-Bereich auf dem Spann kann Luft gut zirkulieren, wodurch die Füße auch bei intensiver Bewegung relativ trocken bleiben. Gerade im Sommer oder bei längeren Einheiten im Fitnessstudio ist das sehr angenehm. Auch die Verarbeitung macht einen guten Eindruck. Die flache Zehennaht verhindert Druckstellen, und dank der Y-förmigen Fersenkonstruktion sitzen die Socken stabil, ohne zu verrutschen. Zudem ist das 6er-Pack sehr praktisch – so hat man genügend Socken für mehrere Trainingstage oder den Alltag. Der Grund, warum ich 4 statt 5 Sterne vergebe, ist, dass sie nach mehreren Waschgängen minimal an Spannung verlieren. Sie bleiben zwar weiterhin bequem und gut tragbar, könnten aber etwas formstabiler sein. Insgesamt bin ich dennoch sehr zufrieden mit den CLOSEMATE Sneaker Socken Herren 6er-Pack. Für Sport, Freizeit und Alltag bieten sie eine gute Kombination aus Komfort, Atmungsaktivität und Preis-Leistung. Ich würde sie auf jeden Fall wieder kaufen.

title: BUON REGGISENO ELASTICO
content: VOTO COMPLESSIVO: 65/100 IL REGGISENO ELASTICO: Pensato per stare comode lungo tutta la giornata e senza problemi di "gravità", questo reggiseno è alquanto buono se si considera la comodità ed il sostegno ma essendo però interamente sintetico trattiene il calore a mio avviso eccessivamente dando fastidio dopo qualche ora. Per come è fatto è oggettivamente uno tra i più comodi da indossare, specialmente per le donne più prosperose che necessitano di una contenzione forte che questo reggiseno fornisce senza sforzo. Proprio questa tenacia però può risultare un po' stringente e dare fastidio alla lunga oltre al calore già citato. Questo a mio avviso è dovuto alla taglia che deve corrispondere quanto di più alla vera e se più piccola crea questo problema. Altro piccolo difetto è nelle spalline che non si regolano granché. PREGI: comodo da indossare anche se non per molto tempo. Sorregge bene. Ben stabile. DIFETTI: se la taglia è leggermente diversa la differenza si sente molto e risulta scomodo. Spalline poco regolabili. Tessuto sintetico che trattiene eccessivamente il calore. Tutto sommato non è male ma penso vada bene per chi ha un corpo ben proporzionato e meno per chi è troppo esile o troppo poco per i motivi detti sopra. In generale lo consiglio perché si adatta piuttosto bene ed aiuta molto lungo la giornata.

author: P. Barclay
title: Have the look and feel of a premium sports sock but are clearly not designed for exercise!
content: Richly coloured, these sports socks are eye-catching and comfortable to wear. I am a woman’s size 6/39 size feet and did think that these men’s socks (6-9) would come up a little too large: not at all. They are not generously sized. I particularly like the 85% breathable cotton mix and heel tabs to prevent the sock from falling into the trainer. Well elasticated, there is a slight support ribbing under the arch of the foot and these are seamless around the heel and toe to prevent chafing and blisters. The socks absorbed sweat well. However, they are untidily finished internally with loose threads - something that is not apparent with brand leaders and more expensive sports socks. Unfortunately, and more importantly, these wear and badly. These are sports socks and should be designed to withstand exercise. After hiking some 20 kms, these socks wore particularly noticeably on the heel. Thinking it may just be a design fault on one pair in the knit, I repeated the exercise only to discover another pair of socks disintegrating on the heel. This is not acceptable. I have no option but to downgrade my rating from what would have been a four-star product to only two. These have the look and feel of a premium brand but are clearly not designed for exercise!

author: *Elena*
title: Comode, traspiranti e resistenti: un ottimo alleato per lo sport e la vita quotidiana
content: Da tempo cercavo delle calze alla caviglia che fossero davvero comode, ma anche adatte a sostenere l’intensità dei miei allenamenti, e devo dire che queste della CLOSEMATE mi hanno positivamente colpita. Le sto usando ormai da un pò sia per le sessioni in palestra sia per le passeggiate all’aperto, e la differenza rispetto a quelle “generiche” si sente eccome. Sono realizzate in cotone pettinato, e appena le ho indossate ho notato subito la morbidezza e la traspirabilità: anche dopo un’ora abbondante di attività, i piedi rimangono asciutti, senza quella fastidiosa sensazione di umidità che spesso si avverte con calze meno tecniche. Inoltre, la presenza della rete traspirante è davvero un dettaglio intelligente che aiuta a mantenere il piede fresco. Un altro aspetto che ho apprezzato moltissimo è la suola leggermente imbottita in spugna: non è eccessivamente spessa, quindi non ingombra, ma fornisce il giusto supporto per assorbire l’impatto quando si corre o si cammina a lungo. L’ammortizzazione è percepibile, soprattutto dopo un’intera giornata in piedi. Il bordo elastico tiene le calze ben ferme, senza stringere o lasciare segni sulle caviglie, e anche durante gli allenamenti più dinamici non ho mai avuto la sensazione che scivolassero o si arrotolassero. La vestibilità è davvero stabile e confortevole, e la punta senza cuciture è un dettaglio che fa la differenza per chi, come me, è soggetta a vesciche o arrossamenti se indossa calze non adatte. Per quanto riguarda la resistenza, dopo diversi lavaggi (sempre a 30° in lavatrice) non si sono sformate né hanno perso elasticità. Tallone e punta sono rinforzati e si vede che sono pensati per durare nel tempo, anche con un uso intensivo. Perché 4 stelle e non 5? L’unico piccolo difetto, se così posso chiamarlo, è che per i miei gusti personali avrei preferito un design un po’ più colorato o originale: sono tutte in tonalità sobrie e classiche, perfette per lo sport, ma magari un po’ meno “vivaci” per chi cerca anche uno stile un po’ più fashion. Ma ovviamente questo è un dettaglio soggettivo. In conclusione, consiglio vivamente queste calze a chi cerca comodità, traspirazione e durata, sia per lo sport che per l’uso quotidiano. È difficile trovare un buon equilibrio tra comfort e prestazioni, ma queste calze ci riescono davvero bene.

title: Era perfetto, ma purtroppo è durata poco
content: Ho perso parecchio peso e ho un seno rilassato così come una pelle non esattamente tonica, te lo anticipo. Purtroppo è cambiato nel tempo, e con tempo intendo mezza giornata. Ora ti racconto: Questo reggiseno, che tra l'altro ha un bellissimo packaging, mi stava perfettamente. Non ha ferretto ed è comodo, rimane aderente senza costringere troppo, la fascia con i gancetti è larga per cui non sega sotto le ascelle se si sceglie la misura giusta. L'effetto era molto bello, quasi di lifting, la misura altrettanto perfetta. Purtroppo, però, le cose sono cambiate in fretta, non hai idea di quanto mi dispiaccia, perché non trovo mai reggiseni così belli. Dopo mezza giornata di utilizzo, notavo che diventava sempre più comodo e questo sembrava un punto a favore. Dopo un po', dopo essermi piegata in avanti per fare qualcosa, ho notato che il reggiseno non reggeva più tanto, e quello che doveva contenere scappava via.. Dopo il lavaggio torna quasi come prima, ma mai del tutto. Ormai lo uso da qualche settimana e ho notato che si è un po' allargato di suo e che quando lo metto non è più come all'inizio, sotto il seno la banda si è allargata e non sostiene molto. Insomma, inizialmente era stupendo e mi piaceva da morire, ho sentito di aver finalmente trovato un reggiseno resistente, ma mi sono dovuta ricredere poco dopo. Ti racconto i dettagli per dirti che il materiale del reggiseno non sembra essere dei migliori, ma che se hai un seno morbido e rilassato, potresti sperimentare quel problema che ti dicevo, quindi fai le tue valutazioni. Nel complesso sono comodi, versatili e convenienti, ideali per running leggero, palestra o lavoro quotidiano. title: Buena calidad y comodidad para running, pero precio alto para una marca desconocida
content: He recibido este pack de 6 pares de calcetines tobilleros CLOSEMATTE a través de Amazon Vine para probarlos y dar mi opinión sincera. Los he usado durante varias sesiones de running y entrenamiento en los últimos días (talla 43-46, color negro). Calidad y acabado: Son muy buenos en este aspecto. Están bien confeccionados, con costuras planas que no molestan, acolchado decente en la planta y talón (reduce impactos y previene ampollas), y un tejido suave de algodón que se siente cómodo desde el primer uso. La elasticidad es adecuada, no aprietan ni se bajan durante la carrera, y el diseño antideslizante en la zona del pie funciona bien (no se mueven dentro del zapato). Transpiran razonablemente y no retienen tanto sudor como calcetines baratos. Función principal: Cumplen perfectamente como calcetines deportivos para running o gym: acolchados donde hace falta, tobilleros que protegen sin subir demasiado, y evitan rozaduras/ampollas en salidas medias-largas. No he tenido problemas de irritación ni deslizamientos, y se lavan bien sin perder forma ni color (ya los he metido en lavadora varias veces). Lo negativo principal: El precio de 23,99 € por 6 pares me parece demasiado elevado para una marca poco conocida como CLOSEMATTE (no es Under Armour ni similar). He comprado packs parecidos de Under Armour (tobilleros acolchados, 6 pares, con buena transpirabilidad y soporte) por menos dinero, y ofrecen materiales técnicos algo más avanzados (mejor gestión de humedad, durabilidad extra). Aquí pagas más por lo mismo o ligeramente inferior en prestaciones premium. Pros: Buen acolchado y comodidad inmediata No se bajan ni generan ampollas Tejido suave, transpirable y lavado fácil Pack de 6 pares práctico y en negro discreto Buena sujeción antideslizante Contras: Precio elevado (23,99 €) comparado con marcas establecidas que cuestan menos por packs similares (compré pack de 3 pares Under Armour por 5 euros hace unas semanas). No destacan en nada "premium" (no hay tecnologías especiales como compresión extra o tejidos ultra transpirables) En resumen, son calcetines sólidos y fiables para uso deportivo diario, con calidad por encima de la media de marcas genéricas, pero no justifican el precio actual si buscas valor por dinero. Si los pillas en oferta o descuento, subirían mucho la nota. Buenos, pero overpriced.

content: Reggiseno Senza Ferretto, color beige scuro Il materiale è effettivamente molto morbido e piacevole sulla pelle. L'ho trovato perfetto per giornate in cui voglio sentirmi comoda senza dover sopportare ferretti fastidiosi. Inoltre, non è affatto "push-up" come dichiarato: piuttosto, tende a schiacciare il seno e a renderlo piatto, il che è stato una grande delusione. Mi aspettavo un supporto migliore e un effetto più valorizzante. Lo vedo più come un reggiseno per il relax, magari per stare in casa o dormire, piuttosto che per uscire o per sentirsi particolarmente valorizzate. Consiglio sicuramente di scegliere una taglia in più rispetto alla propria abituale. Non fa per me, ma potrebbe piacere a chi cerca un'opzione semplice e senza pretese.

title: Ottimo Grip!
content: Iniziamo con il dire che e' un prodotto valido, le cuciture non danno noia e le strisce in gomma fanno il suo dovere, il piede traspira bene, io porto il 44 e la misura e' giusta. Quando si cammina le prime volte fanno un po' di rumore ma dopotutto e' normale cosi come dopo un po' di lavaggi questo tipo di calzature tende a perdere qualche pezzetto di gomma ma non si ripercuote sul suo utilizzo. La calza e' realizzata dal 52,5% da cotone (Pettinato), Il cotone pettinato è una varietà di cotone che viene trattata in modo speciale per rimuovere le fibre più corte e irregolari, ottenendo così un filato più resistente, morbido e di alta qualità. Il restante 34,5 in Nylon, 10% Polyester e 3% Spandex. Per questo tipo di prodotto forse e' sbagliata la compressione e non adatta a tutti, per chi ha i polpacci molto pronunciati puo' esserci qualche problema, per i ragazzi non vedo nessuna controindicazione in quanto la massa muscolare non sara' mai cosi pronunciata. Ho provato anche ad utilizzare le calze per il sim racing ma purtroppo la parte del calcagno tende a fare resistenza quando si usa l'acceleratore e li purtroppo il piede deve scivolare, ottimo invece il grip sui pedali, ma dopotutto non e' un prodotto per questa tipologia di utilizzo. In conclusione e' un buon prodotto destinato a chi gioca al calcio!

title: Cushioned, supportive, and holds up great in the wash
content: I ordered these in a large for daily walks and short gym sessions and they've quickly become my favorite socks in the drawer. The quality is obvious right out of the package, with reinforced heel and toe sections that already look like they will hold up to a lot of wear. The softness is real too, the cotton blend feels gentle against my skin instead of scratchy like some cheaper athletic socks I have tried. Comfort is where these really stand out. The cushioned sole gives a nice padded feel under my foot without making the sock feel bulky inside my shoes, and there is a subtle arch support band that keeps everything snug through a full walk without sliding down into my heel. The fit runs true to size for me, though I noticed the ankle cuff sits a little snug, which is fine for me but might feel tight if you have wider ankles. I have already run these through the wash a few times testing the washability, and they came out holding their shape with no pilling or stretched out cuffs, which was one of my bigger worries with cheaper packs of socks. The mesh panels on top also help keep my feet from getting too warm during longer walks in the summer heat. For durability, I have not seen any thinning at the heel or toe yet, and the stitching still looks clean. Three pairs for the price feels like a fair deal given how well made they are. I would gladly buy these again and recommend them for anyone who wants a comfortable, supportive everyday sock.

author: Athletic Scientist
title: Well made and comfortable; perhaps better for Fall, Spring and Summer
content: What's included: - 6 pairs Mens Dress socks (Large - size: 9-12) The dress socks by Closemate are well made but on the thinner side so they may be better for warmer weather. The socks that I received are Large in size and according to the listing made for those that wear size 9-12 mens shoes. In the package there are a total of 6 pairs of socks and all are solid black in color. The socks are made of a combination of fabric including 80% combed cotton, 15% polyester and 5% spandex. This mix works well allowing for comfort and durability and the spandex ensures that the socks stretch well. According to the listing the socks are reinforced at the toes and heel and while this is true, in wearing them its quite difficult to practically feel this added material although it's there. For me, as a size 9 men's shoe I decided to pick up the large sized version of the socks because I know that I will wash these socks and dry them in a machine, which means the socks are going to shrink which they have (about 5% or so after the initial wash). The socks fit well at this size although they do ride a little high on the leg which is fine for me. The elastic nature of the top of the sock does a good job in holding the socks in place so that they don't slide down while being worn although they did eventually slowly start to come down after about 8-9 hours but given my typical use case, that will be fine going forward. The use of combed cotton is something that I really like in sock because of both the fact that combed cotton fibers increase durability and the socks feel softer on the foot which is important since I often find myself wearing dress shoes which are not always easy on my feet. When I analyzed the insides of the socks I noticed that the size was noted at the top of the sock and so its worth verifying size by flipping them inside out when received. I also can say (as my video verifies) that the socks are well made and stitched without any materially important defects. These consistent and well made socks are both easy to wear and comfortable as a result. Finally when it comes to maintenance, as I noted, I have already been washing these socks in a washing machine and drying them in a dryer and the result is that they do shrink. Ideally, one would like to hand wash and air dry socks made of cotton since it does shrink however, I know that this is something I like to try to do, I often give up after a few times and simply rely on adding such items to my wash. As long as the heat in the dryer is at a reasonable level shrinkage will be acceptable. Overall, the socks wear well, fit well and feel comfortable on foot and have already proven to me that they can be worn for hours - and so they have passed my tests! Well done. Cheers,

title: pros and cons
content: I would say I am generally pleasantly surprised by this bra. It is certainly comfortable and sufficiently supportive. I have given 3 stars for those reasons, and because of the adjustable straps that are easier to reach and slide than most. The reason my rating isn't higher is because there is no separation, and because the sizing could be a bit more inclusive. I can usually wear the size recommended for 34D in this type of soft bra, which doesn't require as precise sizing as a wired bra. So I purchased Large, which fits in the cup, but is a bit loose in the band (so it can't provide any lift.) It would be great if there was a version for the larger cup/smaller band gang! As for the separation: there isn't usually much in wireless bras. The photos of this product are what had me hoping there would be a bit more than usual. I am keeping the bra and wearing it casually, because as I said, it is comfy. If you are a D cup or above, consider this as a sleep or lounge bra.

title: Eher 3,5 Steren, weil "echte Sportsocken"...
content: Fazit: Sport-Sneaker, im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes! Dick und mit gutem Feuchtigkeitsmanagement ausgestattet, aber mit kräftigen (nicht drückenden) Nähten, aber mit viel zu viel Grau bei schwarzen Socken, kann man sie wirklich (hauptsächlich ) nur zum Sport verwenden… Die „Closemate Sneaker Sportsocken“ werden als 6 Paare gebündelt (jeweils ca. 48g), in Schwarz (bei mir Größe 39-42) in einem wiederverschließbaren K, blauen Kunststoffbeutel (291g Gesamtgewicht, 23x16x4,5cm) geliefert. Das Gewebe der Socken besteht aus einer Mischung von 85% Baumwolle, 12% Polyester und 4% Spandex, was eine sehr hohe Hautverträglichkeit und ein sehr angenehmes Tragegefühl mit sich bringt! die Socken sitzen bei Größe 39 (Bestellt 39-42) sehr gut, was auch an dem kräftigen (2,0cm breiten) Gummibund und der Fersenlasche liegen kann. Allgemein finde ich das Gewebe etwas dick geraten (erinnern eher an „Wandersocken-Socken“), und auch die stark „aufgedröselten (Fadenhängenden) Nähte finde ich nicht gerade schön. Aber, auch nach längerem Tragen hatte ich keine Probleme mit „Schweißfüßen“ (Feuchtigkeitsmanagement) oder Druckstellen! Genauso verhält es sich (da leider keine Angaben dazu vorhanden sind), mit einer 40°C Waschmaschinenwäsche, bei der die Socken weder Größe oder Passform verlieren! Störend neben der „Dicke“ ist für mich eigentlich nur die Farbgebung! Wenn man schwarze Sneaker-Socken bestellt und gut 65% der Socken ist Grau, kann man sie wirklich nur als „Sportsocken verwenden – schade! Mit einem Preis von 3,15€ pro Paar liegt man dann im gehobenen Mittelfeld

title: Der Sitz ist sehr bescheiden
content: Ich habe mir den Closemate Nahtloser BH in schwarz in der Größe 3XL kommen lassen. Er ist komplett Nahtlos geformt und hat Polster in den Körbchen. Die Träger sind knapp 2 cm breit und lassen sich einfach verstellen. Er hat drei Reihen mit verstellbaren Hakenverschlüssen. Im Innenteil ist die Waschanleitung eingedruckt. Laut Empfehlung soll man ihn per Hand waschen, ich habe ihn aber zu Testzwecken bei 60 Grad mit meiner normalen dunklen Wäsche mitgewaschen und er sieht noch aus wie vorher. Empfohlen wird aber max. 40 Grad Maschinenwäsche. Ich trage gewöhnlich BH Größe C 100. Mit der gewählten Größe lag ich soweit richtig. Der Umfang passt gut. Jedoch die vorgeformten Körbchen passen gar nicht für meine Größe C. Die Ausformung ist viel zu gering. Es mag bei Körbchengröße A oder B perfekt sitzen, aber ab Körbchengröße C ist hier kein richtiger Halt mehr gegeben. An den Seiten des BHs bilden sich bei mir Stoffwulste die einen Bogen bilden (Siehe Foto). Zudem werden die Brüste einfach nur zusammengequetscht, was keiner normalen Brustform in einem BH entspricht. Hier sollte der Hersteller mitdenken und die Körbchen nach Größen angemessener vorformen, damit die Brüste auch gut hineinpassen. Der Tragekomfort war ansonsten in Ordnung. Schade, ich hatte mich sehr auf diesen BH gefreut, denn es ist sehr schwierig etwas passendes in Großen Größen zu finden das auch noch perfekt passt.

content: A Cold Morning Hike I decided to go hiking one chilly Saturday morning. The weather was crisp, so I put on a pair of thick, warm socks that I recently got. I could feel the warmth keeping my feet cozy. Halfway through, I took a break and checked the socks. They looked fine and still felt warm. However, I remembered the label suggesting to line dry them after washing, which I found a bit inconvenient. But I could manage it if it meant keeping them in good shape. As I finished the hike, my feet remained comfortable, and I was satisfied with my choice.

author: Ailsa S
title: These really don't slip but get a size up
content: These Closemate No Show Socks are comfortable, fit well without being restrictive - even for my diabetic feet and even although there is a seam at the toe. They have a high percentage of cotton which is great for summer activity (80%Cotton 17%Polyester 3%Spandex). They stretch both ways. The top is a mesh pattern to allow for breathability and the cuffs are comfortable and don't cut into the skin like a lot of socks do on my ankles. The bottom is a close knit and the socks look durable despite the high cotton content. They do NOT slip, even a little, and the silicone strips are very comfortable - you won't even know they are there. However, I would advise buying a size up. Mine are medium and I should have ordered the large. I washed the first pair on the tepid water cycle and on normal, and I dried them in the dryer on normal. They shrunk too much and are too tight. That's because cotton shrinks. I knew that but was given them to test so I did, as most people will try to launder them that way. The second time I washed them in cold water on the normal cycle and hung them to dry on the clothes line. They didn't shrink - maybe a teeny bit - but no noticeable difference. The third time I hand-washed them in tepid water, leaving them to soak for fifteen minutes, and laid them on a rack to dry. No shrinkage at all. They come with a handy little case with a zip-tab closure. Not all the socks will fit back into it once opened but you can repurpose it. I keep my crochet hooks in it. The problem is that most people lead very busy lives and will want socks that they can launder in their electric appliances, so buy a size up if possible unless you are willing to air-dry them. They don't show at all in running shoes, but I mostly wear them in my gardening boots. In the warmer weather I don't want hot bulky socks halfway up my knees and these worked perfectly. I wore them for hours and my feet stayed ry and comfortable. They are great little socks and I can recommend them - but buy a bigger size.

author: Una Clienta Más
title: Calcetines deportivos cómodos y acolchados: buen soporte y transpirabilidad para running
content: He estado probando este pack de 6 pares de calcetines deportivos tobilleros CLOSEMATE orientados a running y entrenamiento, y tras utilizarlos en sesiones de deporte y uso diario puedo analizar si realmente cumplen con lo que prometen. Material y construcción Están fabricados con una mezcla de 85 % algodón, 12 % nailon y 3 % elastano, una combinación habitual en calcetines deportivos porque busca equilibrar comodidad, transpirabilidad y elasticidad. El algodón peinado aporta suavidad y capacidad de absorción del sudor, mientras que el nailon y el elastano ayudan a mantener la forma y a mejorar la resistencia al desgaste. Este tipo de mezcla es común en calcetines de running de gama media porque evita que el calcetín se deforme rápidamente y mejora el ajuste al pie. El tejido se siente relativamente grueso en la zona inferior, lo cual es coherente con el acolchado de rizo en talón y antepié. Este acolchado tiene dos funciones: amortiguar impactos durante la pisada y reducir la fricción que suele provocar ampollas en entrenamientos prolongados. Ajuste y soporte Uno de los aspectos más importantes en calcetines deportivos es el ajuste. Este modelo incorpora: Compresión ligera en el arco plantar, que ayuda a mantener el calcetín en su sitio y puede reducir la fatiga del pie durante el ejercicio. Talón con construcción en Y, un diseño ergonómico que mejora la adaptación al talón y evita que el calcetín gire. Costuras suaves en la puntera, pensadas para minimizar roces en los dedos. En uso real se mantienen bastante firmes dentro de la zapatilla, algo importante para evitar deslizamientos. Transpirabilidad La parte superior integra zonas de malla transpirable, que favorecen la ventilación y ayudan a evacuar el sudor. En actividades como correr o entrenamientos de gimnasio se nota que mantienen el pie relativamente seco. Aun así, al tener alto contenido de algodón, su gestión de humedad es correcta pero no tan avanzada como en calcetines técnicos con fibras sintéticas especializadas. Para deporte recreativo o entrenamiento moderado funcionan bien. Comodidad en uso En la práctica destacan por: Sensación suave y mullida gracias al acolchado. Buena elasticidad sin apretar en exceso. Altura tobillera cómoda para zapatillas deportivas. Resultan adecuados tanto para running, gimnasio, caminar o uso diario, especialmente si se busca un calcetín cómodo con algo de amortiguación. Durabilidad La mezcla de algodón con fibras sintéticas suele ofrecer una durabilidad razonable. El refuerzo en zonas de impacto ayuda a retrasar el desgaste, aunque como ocurre con la mayoría de calcetines con alto contenido de algodón, pueden perder algo de elasticidad tras muchos lavados si no se cuidan adecuadamente. Relación calidad-valor Teniendo en cuenta que el pack incluye 6 pares, la relación entre calidad, materiales y funcionalidad es bastante equilibrada dentro de su categoría. Valoración por apartados Comodidad: 9/10 Acolchado agradable y sensación suave en el pie. Transpirabilidad: 8/10 Buena ventilación gracias a la malla, aunque el algodón limita algo la evacuación de humedad frente a tejidos técnicos. Ajuste y soporte: 8,5/10 Buen ajuste con compresión en el arco y talón ergonómico. Calidad de materiales: 8/10 Mezcla equilibrada de algodón y fibras sintéticas habitual en calcetines deportivos. Durabilidad esperada: 7,5/10 Correcta para uso deportivo regular, aunque no al nivel de calcetines técnicos premium. Diseño y versatilidad: 8,5/10 Estilo deportivo limpio y fácil de combinar. ⭐ Valoración global: 8,4 / 10 Son unos calcetines deportivos cómodos, bien acolchados y con buen ajuste, adecuados para running recreativo, gimnasio o uso diario. No llegan al nivel de calcetines técnicos de alto rendimiento, pero dentro de su categoría ofrecen una muy buena combinación de confort, soporte y transpirabilidad.

content: Avevo già dei calzini invernali Closemate che ho indossato tantissimo perché super morbidi e confortevoli, quindi quando ho visto questi calzini sportivi estivi li ho ordinati ben volentieri. Si tratta di un calzino a spessore differenziato, più consistente in punta e tallone e più sottile sul dorso del piede. La texture sul dorso del piede è a nido d'ape, traspirante, mentre al centro del piede abbiamo una fascia leggermente elasticizzata che fa si che il calzino segua perfettamente la forma anatomica del piede rimanendo perfettamente aderente ma senza stringere. La fascia sulla caviglia non è molto alta (personalmente preferisco) ed è ben elasticizzata, con bordino. Anche chi ha la caviglia molto magra sentirà il calzino ben aderente alla caviglia. Le mie caviglie non sono propriamente magre che d'estate qualche volta si gonfiano un po', ma questi calzini non segnano e non stringono, esattamente come la loro versione invernale che ho portato tanto volentieri per mesi. Sono super contenta di aver trovato la versione "estiva" perché indosso molto le sneakers con le quali questi sono perfetti. 5 stelle meritatissime per il confort e la qualità della materia prima (cotone 85%) che si percepisce al tatto, oltre che la buona fattura. author: bubbs90
title: Only 30% merino…is it really a wool sock?
content: My feet have worn some very nice wool socks. Yes, all of them have been wool blends, but none with less than ~55% real live merino wool. I’m not sure it’s fair to market these as “wool” socks when wool isn’t even the isn’t even the majority fiber. It would be more accurate to call these Acrylic socks with Merino wool and Nylon. Here’s the listed fiber breakdown: 35% Acrylic, 30% Merino Wool, 22% Nylon, 10% Polyester and 3% Spandex. None of this would matter to me and my feet if all those synthetics faded into the background and the socks felt like wool. Breathable. Temp regulating- warm when it’s cold out, cool and moisture wicking when it’s warmer. These feel slimy. Indulge me in a quick trip down memory lane. Maybe half an hour into a car ride to the outskirts of Berlin, my kids’ grandma turned to me and said in German, “Show me your foot”. I did, and as we pulled into our destination 3 to 3 1/2 hours later, she hands me a pair of German grandma hand knit wool sock that fit perfectly. They were probably 80% wool and 20% nylon. Most comfortable socks ever. Next best are an assortment of smartwool products that have been anywhere from 55 to 75% merino wool. Unfortunately, while these seem like a good buy, they really don’t feel like wool socks. I’m sitting here wearing a pair of these, and I can feel my feet overheating. Not good. And maybe that slimy feeling will fade with a few washes, but right now I’m about to peel them off so my tootsies can breathe. Maybe these will work for you if your feet haven’t been spoiled with German grandma wool socks. Even if you’ve worn quality socks from SW or other makers, these may fall short in comparison. Happy feet, happy me. But no so far with these socks.

title: Comfortable, both in fit and fabric
content: I like these quite a bit. Which isn't useful for you readers, so let me expand. They are a wool blend, less than 30% wool, but they're still a standout sock compared to cheap store multipacks. First, they still *fit* like the nylon cotton socks I normally purchase, but the material is noticeably softer and smoother on the skin. Second, they do retain heat better than my usuals, which is nice with the colder fall weather now upon us. They seem to do a decent job of moisture wicking, but that's always hard to tell in the long term, as I'm a foot sweater, and they can get overloaded. My niggle, is the "cushioned" claim. They *may* be fractionally thicker on the bottom, but I'd have to get a micrometer to be certain. Absolutely no more so than the "reinforced" socks I'd buy. So take that claim with a bit of caution.

They have a small grippy strip inside the back of the heel so they don’t slide down into your shoes when you walk/run. content: Questi calzini sono comodissimi. Io ho un piede di misura 42.5 (circa 26.5 cm) e la taglia 39-42 (che viene semplicemente indicata come M) mi calza a pennello, non risultando stretta nonostante i miei timori. I calzini fasciano bene il collo del piede senza stringere grazie all’anello elasticizzato centrale, dando comunque libertà di movimento alle dita. Presentano dei cuscinetti imbottiti molto morbidi sulla parte anteriore e dietro all’anello centrale (ma non sul tallone), che attutiscono molto bene la pressione e permettono di ritardare sensibilmente il fastidio tipico di quando si corre e/o cammina per parecchi km. Inoltre, la linguetta posteriore, utile per indossarli più facilmente ed evitare le tipiche piaghe che sorgono con scarpe basse, è imbottita, fornendo ulteriore protezione. L’unico aspetto “negativo” che mi sento di segnalare (ma è relativo) è che probabilmente la morbidezza extra si trasformerà in sensazione di calore eccessiva con l’estate: io li sto usando con temperature miti di fine inverno e in questo periodo forniscono un calore più che sufficiente. Altra cosa, avrei preferito che la confezione contenesse 3 paia bianchi e 3 neri, anziché 4 e 2. La durata in questo tipo di prodotti è cruciale: per ora, dopo pochi lavaggi, nessun problema: aggiornerò la recensione se dovessero sorgerne in futuro.
